name: Remocn
notes: MIT (all of it). Hard prerequisite: Remotion — every component renders video frames inside a Remotion composition, not interactive web UI.

Registry index has 938 items (929 components + 9 lib). Cataloged = the 825 components in the official llms-components.txt index + the 100 animated icons (icons gallery). Skipped: sub-part rows (command-menu-item, dropdown-menu-item, select-item) and the brush ink helper.

components.name: Agent Run
components.description: Animated brand-neutral AI agent run — a Thinking status and short plan, tool calls whose spinners close into checks while a timer counts real seconds, then a markdown answer with citations and a code block that streams in irregular token bursts. Light/dark themes.
components.useFor: A product demo needs the beat after the prompt, where an AI agent plans, calls tools and lands on a specific answer.

components.name: ChatGPT
components.description: Animated ChatGPT composer — types a prompt into the pill input, the blue voice button morphs into a send button, and the suggestion chips fade out. Light/dark themes.
components.useFor: Announcing a ChatGPT integration or GPT-powered feature where the OpenAI brand must be recognizable.

components.name: Claude Chat
components.description: Animated Claude chat input — types a prompt character-by-character and the waveform button morphs into a terracotta send button the moment text appears. Warm light/dark themes.
components.useFor: Announcing a Claude integration or Anthropic-powered feature where the Claude brand must be visible.

components.name: Claude Code
components.description: Animated Claude Code CLI welcome screen — terminal window with a dashed welcome box, recent activity and what's new panels, and a prompt line that types a command with a block cursor. Dark/light themes.
components.useFor: Depicting a Claude Code / agentic-CLI workflow as a recognizable branded surface in a dev-tool demo.

components.name: OpenCode
components.description: Animated OpenCode TUI welcome screen — two-tone wordmark, an input box with a blue accent bar that types a query, a model status line, and command hints. Dark/light themes.
components.useFor: Depicting the OpenCode TUI as a recognizable branded surface in a dev-tool demo.

components.name: v0
components.description: Animated Vercel v0 composer — types a prompt into the dark textarea and the mic button morphs into a send button. Dark/light themes.
components.useFor: Depicting the Vercel v0 composer as a recognizable branded surface in a generative-UI demo.

components.name: Ecosystem Constellation
components.description: A central logo orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines.
components.useFor: The story is "we plug into everything" — one hub product ringed by the tools it connects to.

components.name: Infinite Bento Pan
components.description: A camera diagonally drifts across an oversized bento grid behind a soft vignette.
components.useFor: You need an ambient establishing shot that says "a lot is happening here" without asking anyone to read a single number.

components.name: Live Code Compilation
components.description: Split-screen where typed code on the left snaps a live UI preview on the right, HMR-style.
components.useFor: You want to show cause and effect for a developer audience: a style prop finishes typing on the left and the button on the right changes on that exact frame.

components.name: Confetti
components.description: Deterministic confetti burst for Remotion — seeded particles with gravity, spin, and flutter so every render is identical. Fire it on any frame as a celebratory overlay.
components.useFor: A milestone moment needs a celebratory payoff — product launch, plan completion, success screen.

components.name: Crumple Toss
components.description: Crushes an element into a ball of paper and throws it out of frame on an arc, leaving the scene around it running.
components.useFor: Discarding something on screen — the old plan, the wrong answer, the previous version.

components.name: Cursor Gravity
components.description: A rounded triangular cursor tugs a button out of the screen edge with pulsed elastic resistance.
components.useFor: An empty scene should reveal a call to action through a physical pulling gesture.

components.name: Glass Lens
components.description: A glass lens drop magnifies a headline word, glides to a clip and flattens into a CTA pill.
components.useFor: A launch video that moves from a headline to a product screen to a call to action in one continuous motion.

components.name: Ink Arrow
components.description: A hand-drawn brush arrow that sweeps itself from one point to another, thickening into the head that pops on the final poses.
components.useFor: A hand-drawn annotation should point from one thing to another — callouts over paper or scrapbook scenes.

components.name: Keystroke
components.description: Physical keycaps rise in for each shortcut, press in real order with the modifiers held while the letter taps, spring back with a small capped overshoot, and leave after an idle hold, firing on the same frames as the remocn-ui steps they trigger.
components.useFor: A product demo shows a keyboard-first flow, such as a command palette, an editor or a triage queue, and the viewer should see the keys behind each action.

components.name: Paper Wobble
components.description: Per-pose reshoot jitter that makes any content feel hand-placed on a desk.
components.useFor: Any block should carry the stop-motion reshoot wobble — headlines, cards, or content that must feel hand-placed rather than laid out.

components.name: Radial Burst
components.description: Sculptural ribbons twist into a tilted ring and sweep outward through contour echoes for an expressive product introduction.
components.useFor: A product introduction needs a short abstract geometric opening before its title.

components.name: Scribble Circle
components.description: A brush circle swept around a region of the frame, opening thin and closing thick, with grain breaking up the dry opening.
components.useFor: Circling the one element that matters — a button, a number, a row in a screenshot.

components.name: Simulated Cursor
components.description: Animated mouse cursor moving between waypoints with click ripple feedback.
components.useFor: You are narrating a screen demo and need a synthetic cursor that moves predictably over a UI screenshot or recording

components.name: TV Power Off
components.description: End a scene the way a tube does: the picture collapses into a glowing horizontal line, the line pinches to a phosphor dot, the dot decays, and the frame is left dead black.
components.useFor: A scene should end like a device being switched off rather than fading out — the picture collapses, a dot lingers, and the frame is dead.

components.name: Cloth Reveal
components.description: A satin sheet draped over the content is yanked from one corner, folding and fluttering as a simulated cloth before it clears the frame.
components.useFor: A logo, product or headline should be unveiled like a launch-event reveal.

components.name: Dolly Zoom
components.description: The vertigo shot: a perspective corridor with a red door stretches deeper while the subject in the center holds its exact size.
components.useFor: A realization or a turning point in the story needs one unsettling, cinematic beat.

components.name: Exploded View
components.description: An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together.
components.useFor: An architecture or a product stack should be explained layer by layer, such as interface, engine, storage and hardware.

components.name: Gravity Pile
components.description: Seeded circles, squares and triangles rain down, bounce off the floor and each other, and settle into a heap.
components.useFor: A beat about volume should feel physical, such as a pile of tasks, tickets or features.

components.name: Impact Shake
components.description: Heavy content slams in from above with squash, a damped camera jolt, a two-frame RGB split and dust puffs kicking out sideways.
components.useFor: A launch word, a price or a logo should land like it weighs a ton.

components.name: Layered Cutout
components.description: The camera dollies through layered cut sheets to land on a framed Remocn logo.
components.useFor: A logo or brand reveal that should feel tactile and dimensional, like paper cut by hand.

components.name: Parallax Depth
components.description: A flat landscape built from depth layers trucks sideways with a gentle push-in, near layers sliding faster than far ones.
components.useFor: An opener or a quiet beat needs a cinematic establishing shot, a slow sideways camera move across a sun and hills.

components.name: Tiny Planet
components.description: A seeded flat skyline bends into a tiny planet through a polar remap, then slowly spins beside a red sun.
components.useFor: A story about a city, a community or a global product needs a playful world-building beat.

components.name: Turntable
components.description: A product card spins on an invisible turntable through front, edge and back in real 3D, with face shading and a breathing floor shadow.
components.useFor: A physical-looking object, such as a credit card, a membership pass or a ticket, should be shown from every side.

components.name: Blueprint
components.description: The product wipes left to right into a technical drawing: blueprint grid, white linework, dimension lines with ticks, labels and a red callout.
components.useFor: A hardware or product launch should show the object as an engineering drawing: measured, labelled and precise.

components.name: Brick Mosaic
components.description: Toy bricks drop in row by row from the bottom with a tiny bounce, rebuilding a pixel-art logo on a baseplate.
components.useFor: A logo, icon or emoji should be built out of toy bricks, one row at a time, for a playful reveal.

components.name: Comic Panels
components.description: The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines, red halftone and a starburst, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame POW.
components.useFor: A logo, product or headline should land with comic-book energy, framed in a hero panel with speed lines.

components.name: Duotone Beat
components.description: A two-ink halftone portrait swaps its ink pair on every beat, with a punch-in on the downbeat and a bar indicator.
components.useFor: A speaker, artist or team portrait should hit on the beat of a track, poster-style, for a promo or social cut.

components.name: Embossed Mark
components.description: The R mark and wordmark are debossed into a brushed grey surface as it lights up.
components.useFor: A premium logo sign-off where the brand looks pressed into paper or metal.

components.name: Fluted Glass
components.description: Fluted glass refracts a gradient orb and its headline, clearing as it comes into focus.
components.useFor: A premium headline reveal that starts distorted and resolves to a sharp, clean title.

components.name: Frosted Clear
components.description: A frosted glass card clears to show a large 10x stat with a kicker.
components.useFor: Revealing one headline number ("10x") with a short label after building suspense behind frosted glass.

components.name: Led Ticker
components.description: REMOCN IS LIVE scrolls on a retro LED dot-matrix with a gradient on the last word.
components.useFor: A short announcement ("remocn is live") that should read like a stadium or station sign.

components.name: Line Boil
components.description: A hand-drawn outline boils like a cel animation, redrawn every few frames with a varying pen weight, then fills with color while it keeps boiling.
components.useFor: A simple mark, icon or shape should feel hand-animated, with the restless line of traditional cel animation.

components.name: Long Shadow
components.description: A flat icon casts a long shadow to the frame edge, then the light swings and the shadow sweeps around on a spring.
components.useFor: A flat icon, badge or logo mark should get the classic flat-design long shadow, with a little motion in it.

components.name: Riso Print
components.description: A two-ink risograph print: the accent plate slides in off-register, wobbles and settles a hair out of alignment over grainy paper.
components.useFor: A title card, poster or logo should arrive as if it came off a two-color risograph, with visible misregistration and ink speckle.

components.name: Synthwave
components.description: A retro neon horizon: a scrolling perspective grid, a rising striped sun and mountain ranges that slide in.
components.useFor: A scene needs an 80s retro backdrop: a music drop, a gaming or nostalgia beat, a late-night product teaser.

components.name: X-Ray Scan
components.description: A glowing scanner bar sweeps across a device, turning the shell dark and revealing white-line internals with one part in red.
components.useFor: A hardware launch should show what is inside the device: the board, the battery, the chip that matters.

components.name: Backdrop
components.description: Configurable full-frame background (color / gradient / image / live component) with Screen Studio-style padding and a rounded, shadowed content frame.
components.useFor: You need a scene background — wrap every composition in `Backdrop` rather than hardcoding background colors on individual components.

components.name: Chat to Preview Layout
components.description: Two-column layout where chat shrinks and preview expands.
components.useFor: Showing an AI agent at work — the conversation starts as the subject, then yields the frame to what it produced

components.name: Drift
components.description: A slow linear camera push-in wrapper that scales its scene from 1 to 1+grow across the sequence so no frame is ever static.
components.useFor: Any static scene should feel alive — hero cards, feature panels, dashboards sitting between transitions.

components.name: Stage
components.description: Place a screenshot, recording, or long page on a perspective studio plane and direct an integrated camera across it with timeline keyframes.
components.useFor: A product screen, website, image, or live React scene should read as a photographed object rather than a flat full-frame capture.

components.name: Before After
components.description: A divider sweeps across a photo to reveal the graded version of an ungraded still.
components.useFor: Showing a color grade, edit, retouch or redesign as a before and after.

components.name: Device Morph
components.description: A design canvas switches a frame between desktop, tablet and phone layouts.
components.useFor: Showing that a product or site is responsive, with the layout actually reflowing at each size.

components.name: Grid Montage
components.description: One shot splits into a 2x2 then a 3x3 montage, cutting on the beat.
components.useFor: A rhythmic recap montage of many scenes or screenshots cut to a beat.

components.name: Looks Like This
components.description: "Your next launch looks like this." above a Remocn Studio screenshot tile.
components.useFor: A promise line such as what your next launch looks like, where the image is the answer.

components.name: Panel Split
components.description: A portfolio page splits into stacked panels of bio, case study and reel.
components.useFor: An about-me or studio intro that grows from a single hero panel into a bento of bio, work and reel.

components.name: Screenshot Tour
components.description: The camera tours a product screenshot, zooming in on regions of an issue tracker.
components.useFor: A guided walkthrough of one screenshot with three or so labelled regions.

components.name: Shards to Grid
components.description: Shards of images snap into a media grid with a "Every frame, written in code" label.
components.useFor: A media-heavy product beat that goes from a scatter of visuals to an organized grid.

components.name: Shot Answers
components.description: A screenshot tile slides beside "Your launch video is just another pull request.".
components.useFor: A question-and-answer beat where the answer reuses most of the question's words.

components.name: Theme Flip
components.description: A product UI flips between dark and light themes with a cursor trigger.
components.useFor: Showing a dark mode or theme switch as a circular reveal flooding out from the toggle.

components.name: Up Close
components.description: A screenshot zooms close, captioned "Up close, it's code. From here, it's your launch.".
components.useFor: A two-part line such as up close it is one thing, from afar another, anchored on a real image.

components.name: Bauhaus Build
components.description: Flat Bauhaus circles, arcs, squares and bars tumble corner over corner on a hidden grid into an asymmetric frieze, then rebuild into two friezes around an open band for the title.
components.useFor: A launch or chapter opener should build an abstract geometric poster and end on an open band for the title.

components.name: Chord Ring
components.description: Chords link a ring of integration names around a glowing center that reads "Connects to everything".
components.useFor: An integrations beat showing that your product connects with many tools around a central hub.

components.name: Dot Field Morph
components.description: A drifting field of dots swirls into icon shapes, then gathers into the logo.
components.useFor: A feature tour where each capability is an icon formed from dots, ending on your logo.

components.name: Flock Form
components.description: A flock of birds flies in, forms an arrow, then settles into the R mark.
components.useFor: A logo reveal where hundreds of small shapes assemble into your brand mark.

components.name: Flow Field
components.description: Hundreds of particles ride a seeded noise field, leaving silky fading trails in a seamless loop.
components.useFor: A title card, quote or hero shot needs a quiet, organic line texture behind it that keeps moving without drawing attention.

components.name: Fourier Sum
components.description: Sine harmonics add up one by one into a square wave under a serif caption.
components.useFor: Explaining how many simple parts combine into one result ("Many parts. One signal.").

components.name: Isometric Build
components.description: An isometric tile grid springs up row by row into a stepped block sculpture with one accent tower, then holds.
components.useFor: An opener or section break should build something in about a second, a small city or stack that reads as infrastructure, platform or growth.

components.name: Life Grid
components.description: Conway's Game of Life plays out on a seeded grid, with newborn cells flashing in the accent.
components.useFor: A tech, AI or simulation story needs a background that visibly computes, with rule-based structures forming, colliding and dying.

components.name: Mondrian Split
components.description: Black lines cut the frame into a seeded De Stijl grid, primaries wipe into its cells, the grid reflows like rubber, and one cell pushes its own lines out past the edges to become a clean color field or the next scene.
components.useFor: A launch, section break, or product intro needs a bold, flat geometric opener that ends on a clean color field for the title.

components.name: Path Search
components.description: A pathfinding search floods a grid and traces the route from start to goal.
components.useFor: Explaining routing, search or an AI agent finding a path around obstacles.

components.name: Pattern Tile
components.description: A quarter-disc tile is rotated, mirrored and translated into a wall of 72 tiles.
components.useFor: Explaining how a pattern or design system is built from one rule repeated and transformed.

components.name: Pendulum Wave
components.description: A row of pendulums with tuned periods drifts from a straight line into waves and braids, then realigns for a seamless loop.
components.useFor: A scene needs a calm, hypnotic background loop that is clearly rule-based, with order dissolving into waves and snapping back into a line.

components.name: Phyllotaxis
components.description: Seeds spiral out at the golden angle into a sunflower head, then an accent Fibonacci arm pulses outward.
components.useFor: An opener or section break should grow something natural and precise in about two seconds, then keep a gentle idle motion.

components.name: Ring Align
components.description: Concentric dotted rings rotate until their slots align and reveal a word in the channel.
components.useFor: A reveal of a single word ("Aligned.") that should feel like a lock clicking into place.

components.name: Speed Lines
components.description: Parallel streaks trail an element as it flies in at its real speed, the element stretching with that speed and landing with a squash and a small bounce as the streaks die, or radial lines rush in from the frame edges and snap onto one point for a manga-style impact frame.
components.useFor: An element should make a sharp entrance, such as a card, logo, or number that flies in fast, stretches with its speed, and lands with weight, overshooting a little and squashing on impact, while streaks trail it and die as it lands.

components.name: Squiggle
components.description: A flat line draws itself along a straight course as a traveling wave whose crests swim forward and calm down as the head runs out, in wave, zigzag, loop or coil shapes, then erases toward its end point.
components.useFor: A word, a number, or a button needs a live underline or accent on the frame it lands, such as a click, a count finishing, or a beat.

components.name: String Art
components.description: Threads string a ring of pins times-table style while the multiplier morphs from cardioid to nephroid and beyond.
components.useFor: A math, algorithm or engineering story needs a precise generative figure that builds itself and then transforms.

components.name: Topo Lines
components.description: Topographic contour lines around a few seeded peaks breathe and shift in a seamless loop, one contour picked out in the accent color.
components.useFor: A title, quote or section card needs a quiet line texture behind it that moves slowly enough to read over.

components.name: Trim Burst
components.description: A ring of short straight strokes shoots out from a point like Trim Paths: each end races ahead on a hard-braking ease-out while its start holds, then chases it on a smoother ease-in-out, so every stroke grows, travels and zips shut at its outer distance.
components.useFor: A click, tap or toggle needs a quick punctuation mark, a ring of strokes that zips out from the point and is gone in about half a second.

components.name: Truchet Flip
components.description: Quarter-circle Truchet tiles snap a quarter turn as a wave crosses the grid, rerouting continuous lines until they settle into concentric loops, a calm field, or a circle of small rings.
components.useFor: A scene needs a flat geometric pattern bed that moves by one rule, each tile turning a quarter as a wave passes and the lines reconnecting across the frame.

components.name: Venn Merge
components.description: Two circles labelled Design and Code overlap, and the lens fills with the logo.
components.useFor: Explaining that your product sits at the overlap of two or three disciplines.

components.name: Accordion Unfold
components.description: A tight paper zigzag unfolds sideways into a flat card with the logo printed across it.
components.useFor: A print, stationery, travel or editorial brand wants a tactile reveal, like opening a folded brochure or map.

components.name: Anamorphic Flare
components.description: A point of light grows into a cinematic anamorphic streak that sweeps the frame and reveals the logo in its wake.
components.useFor: A film, studio, automotive or premium product needs a cinematic opener with a lens-flare look.

components.name: Bass Drop
components.description: A trailer build-up breathes in, then drops into the big gradient logo with a tracked tagline.
components.useFor: A trailer-style opener that builds tension before revealing the product name.

components.name: Blink Cut
components.description: Words blink in a fixed rhythm before cutting to the logo and a one-line tagline.
components.useFor: A fast, loud word montage that ends on the product name.

components.name: Bounce Logo
components.description: The wordmark bounces around the frame like an old DVD logo until it hits the corner.
components.useFor: A playful, meme-aware sting for a casual product or community video.

components.name: Bracket Index
components.description: Indexed bracket labels step through words before the brackets close around the product name.
components.useFor: A for-X, for-Y, for-Z beat that lists use cases before naming the product.

components.name: Collab Lockup
components.description: The Remocn logo and a partner logo join with an x under a glowing arc and caption.
components.useFor: A partnership or integration announcement with two brands.

components.name: CTA Collapse Mark
components.description: Call-to-action content collapses into the Remocn wordmark over a glowing planet horizon.
components.useFor: The final beat of a launch film: a call to action and URL that resolve into the logo.

components.name: Dynamic Letter
components.description: The wordmark appears while one letter morphs through shapes before settling as the final O.
components.useFor: A logo sting for a design or type product that should show the identity is flexible.

components.name: First Light
components.description: The remocn wordmark is swept by a band of light along a baseline, with a tagline below.
components.useFor: A calm, premium logo reveal at the very start or end of a launch film.

components.name: Flip Sting
components.description: The logo flips into place with a small tracked line settling under it.
components.useFor: A kinetic logo sting where the letters act as a stencil for rapid flat frames.

components.name: Flood Sting
components.description: A flood of blue fills the frame and the Remocn wordmark lands between two dots.
components.useFor: A tool-picker or integrations beat that should end by flooding into the brand.

components.name: Giant Mark Backdrop
components.description: A huge wordmark scrolls behind a floating prompt card on a warm paper ground.
components.useFor: A prompt-to-video or AI-assistant beat where the typed request lands on a giant brand backdrop.

components.name: Glyph Block Decode
components.description: Blocky glyphs decode into "Remocn Studio" with its URL underlined beneath.
components.useFor: A name reveal for a studio or product with a URL the viewer should remember.

components.name: Glyph Matrix
components.description: A round LED dot matrix counts 3-2-1, then its dots hop into the R mark and the logo.
components.useFor: A countdown to launch that ends in the logo.

components.name: Gravity Grid
components.description: A grid bends into a gravity well and the logo lands at its bottom.
components.useFor: A physics-flavoured reveal for a platform with weight and gravity as the metaphor.

components.name: Heat Trace
components.description: The remocn wordmark is traced in a warm-to-cool gradient heat line, with a tagline beneath.
components.useFor: A developer-tool or hardware launch where a thermal glow suits the brand.

components.name: Inflate
components.description: A deflated red sliver puffs up like a balloon toy, overshoots, squashes wide and settles into a glossy rounded mark.
components.useFor: A consumer, kids or casual app wants a soft, bouncy brand moment with a toy-like feel.

components.name: Ink Bloom
components.description: Ink blooms across the page and settles into the Remocn logo.
components.useFor: A craft, editorial or analogue-flavoured brand reveal.

components.name: Introducing
components.description: 'Introducing' settles then lifts into an eyebrow as the remocn wordmark lands with a tagline.
components.useFor: A product announcement that opens with Introducing and a one-line tagline.

components.name: Light Signature
components.description: A red horizontal light streak flares as the remocn wordmark appears under 'The all-new'.
components.useFor: A new-version reveal that carries a short eyebrow such as The all-new.

components.name: Light Trail Write
components.description: A point of light writes the Remocn wordmark path with a cooling trail.
components.useFor: A logo reveal that should feel hand-written with light.

components.name: Liquid Fill
components.description: A drop falls into an outlined mark and liquid rises with a sloshing, damping surface and bubbles until the mark is solid.
components.useFor: A beverage, fintech or utility brand wants a reveal about filling up, loading or topping off.

components.name: Logo Construct
components.description: A blueprint grid draws the logo construction lines and the wordmark inks in.
components.useFor: A design-system or brand-identity launch that wants to show how the mark is built.

components.name: Neon Sign
components.description: A glass neon tube stutters alive segment by segment with a hot white core and wall glow, buzzes off once, then holds lit.
components.useFor: The brand, venue or event has a nightlife, retro or hand-lettered feel and the sting should look like a lit sign.

components.name: Neural Pulse
components.description: A neural network fires a prompt through its nodes and resolves into the Remocn logo.
components.useFor: An AI product launch where a prompt goes in and the brand comes out.

components.name: Noise Forge Sting
components.description: The Remocn wordmark forges out of noise on a warm glow, tagline fading in below.
components.useFor: A launch opener that wants a heated, forged reveal of the brand.

components.name: Orbit Lock
components.description: Three moons ride tilted, shrinking orbits into a red core that bursts into a ring flash and springs the logo into place.
components.useFor: A tech, AI or infrastructure product needs an opener or closer where the logo arrives out of a small physical event.

components.name: Paper Plane
components.description: A dotted flight path loops past three stops and lands on the Remocn wordmark.
components.useFor: A write, render, launch workflow beat that ends on the brand.

components.name: Photo Halo
components.description: The Remocn wordmark sits next to a halo of circular photo thumbnails.
components.useFor: A community or customer beat: a headline over real faces or screenshots that gather beside the logo.

components.name: Play of The Game
components.description: A 'Play of the Game' banner slices in over the remocn logo with a role label and stat.
components.useFor: A playful recap or hero-stat beat for a solo-builder launch, like shipped in 6 hours.

components.name: Puzzle Snap
components.description: Geometric pieces spin in from scattered positions and magnet-snap into a mark with a spark burst, then the mark slides aside for the wordmark.
components.useFor: You have a wordmark but no animated mark, and the sting should build a simple geometric mark for you.

components.name: Quadtree Mark
components.description: The R mark is built from subdividing pixel squares that refine into a sharp logo.
components.useFor: A logo reveal for an imaging, graphics or codec product, with pixels refining into the mark.

components.name: Ripple Mark
components.description: Dots ripple across the frame and assemble the Remocn logo.
components.useFor: A logo reveal that starts from a dot field, suited to a data or infrastructure brand.

components.name: Sequel Numeral
components.description: The remocn wordmark opens beside a giant red numeral 2 with 'Part two. Out now.'.
components.useFor: A v2 or sequel announcement where the version number is the hero.

components.name: Shape Morph O
components.description: A shape morphs into the O of the wordmark beside the R mark.
components.useFor: A playful logo reveal where one letter of the brand starts as a shape.

components.name: Signal Resolve
components.description: Noisy scope traces resolve to a clean line and the logo with Less noise. More signal.
components.useFor: A message about cutting through noise, such as monitoring, search or analytics.

components.name: Snap Click
components.description: The wordmark snaps together at a seam with a click, settling over a subtle caption.
components.useFor: A short, punchy logo sting with a tactile click.

components.name: Spell Out
components.description: "remocn" spells out in big lowercase letters with "Say it once. Remember it." beneath.
components.useFor: A name people mispronounce, where spelling it out is the hook.

components.name: Split Match
components.description: Split-flap reels lock onto each word in turn, the last one becoming the big logo.
components.useFor: A tagline made of a few short words, like build, ship, launch, that ends on the brand.

components.name: Spotlight
components.description: A soft spotlight cone searches the dark stage, overshoots, and lands on the logo before the house lights lift.
components.useFor: A launch, keynote or event video should open with a theatrical reveal, the logo waiting in the dark until the light finds it.

components.name: Squircle Wave
components.description: A wave of squircle cells sweeps across a dot grid and leaves the R mark behind.
components.useFor: A text-free logo reveal where a wave of motion ends on the mark alone.

components.useFor: A trend beat with several layers over time where one layer swells into the headline share.

components.name: Stripe Count
components.description: A huge 184 counts up on an orange band with a dark bold number and a caption above.
components.useFor: A loud, brand-colored stat beat where the whole frame becomes the accent color.

components.name: Studio Reflection
components.description: A chrome-gradient 250+ appears with studio-style reflection and a small caption.
components.useFor: A product-shot style hero number such as the size of a library.

components.name: T Minus
components.description: A mission clock ticks T-minus with rolling characters, then slams 'LIFTOFF' over a sunrise glow.
components.useFor: A release-day beat framed as a mission countdown: a T-minus clock ticks to zero and 'LIFTOFF' slams in over a sunrise glow.

components.name: Tall Count
components.description: A tall condensed orange-gradient +240% counts up beside a three-line caption.
components.useFor: A percentage-gain headline such as +240 percent.

components.name: Tally Marks
components.description: Hand-drawn tally marks fill rows until they resolve into the 1,240 count.
components.useFor: A paper or hand-made beat where a big count should be earned one stroke at a time.

components.name: The Tab
components.description: A receipt of dotted lines prices every item at $0, totalling "one Sunday morning".
components.useFor: A what-you-get beat where every included item carries the same price, such as zero.

components.name: Thin Slab
components.description: A big '1 day' contrasted with a thin progress slab labeled 14x faster than by hand.
components.useFor: A time-saved beat that squeezes a thick slab for the old duration down to a thin one for the new duration while the number counts across.

components.name: Thread Weave
components.description: A number is woven thread by thread on a loom of cream cells in blue and orange.
components.useFor: A craft-flavoured beat where a figure should look built row by row.

components.name: Ticker Tape
components.description: A stock-style ticker symbol with price and green percent change over a scrolling tape.
components.useFor: A funding, valuation or growth moment told as a market quote.

components.name: Time Breakdown
components.description: A segmented time bar shrinks while 56% less time per video counts up.
components.useFor: A time-saved claim where the segments of a workflow, such as editing, rendering and export, visibly shrink.

components.name: Timer Duel
components.description: Two stopwatch timers run side by side, the faster one ending on 38x faster.
components.useFor: A speed-comparison beat where two stopwatches start together and the faster one stops first, with a big multiplier left on screen.

components.name: Times Turn
components.description: A multiplication sign flips on an orange panel next to a large 3 with a caption.
components.useFor: A multiplier claim such as 3x, where a percent sign flips into a times sign.

components.name: Timing Tower
components.description: A racing timing tower reorders until the hero car sits at a big P1 with a gap time.
components.useFor: A we-moved-up-the-ranking beat with a motorsport feel.

components.name: Treemap Split
components.description: A treemap splits into category tiles, the biggest tile in gradient with a 38% label.
components.useFor: A catalog or usage breakdown where one category, such as 38%, is the headline and the rest are context.

components.name: Unit Grid
components.description: A 10x10 dot grid lights up 33 dots next to a 33 / 100 stat line.
components.useFor: A one in three or 33 percent claim shown as a countable share of dots.

components.name: Uptime Strip
components.description: A strip of ticks fills in green while 99.99% uptime types out beside an italic word.
components.useFor: A reliability beat for an API, hosting or infrastructure product.

components.name: Version Hero
components.description: A chrome 2.0 version numeral rises inside a glowing ring with Now available beneath.
components.useFor: A release announcement where the version number is the hero.

components.name: Versus Split
components.description: A diagonal split frames remocn against the old way with stat rows for time, cost and rounds.
components.useFor: A head-to-head beat that pits the product against the old way on a diagonal split with a tale-of-the-tape of time, cost and effort.

components.name: Waterfall Chart
components.description: A revenue waterfall steps through gains and losses into a gradient total of $84k MRR.
components.useFor: A revenue or metric bridge where gains and losses step from a start value to a total, such as $84k MRR.

components.name: Weight Cut
components.description: A large light-weight figure counts up to 6.8 KB as its strokes thin, with a small caps eyebrow.
components.useFor: A size or weight stat, such as kilobytes saved, where the type itself should get lighter as the number shrinks.

components.name: Zero Stretch
components.description: The zero in '200' stretches into a glossy pill that holds the word 'components'.
components.useFor: A count claim such as 200 components, where the unit word sits inside the number.

components.name: AI Answer Sources
components.description: An AI answer streams in with inline citations and source chips below.
components.useFor: A product beat showing an AI search or research assistant answering a question with cited sources.

components.name: AI Image Grid
components.description: An AI image generator fills a result with a generated render and Download button.
components.useFor: A product beat for an image generation tool: type a prompt, watch variations resolve, pick one.

components.name: Analytics Funnel
components.description: An activation funnel chart steps down while a tooltip shows breakdowns.
components.useFor: An analytics or growth product launch that needs to show a conversion funnel with real-looking drop-off per step.

components.name: App Store Listing
components.description: A phone app store listing with ratings and screenshot carousel gets an Open button.
components.useFor: A mobile app launch video that needs the now-on-the-store beat with rating, rank and screenshots.

components.name: Audit Boxes
components.description: Off-spec elements of a UI get traced with red boxes, each with the fix it needs, while an issue counter ticks up.
components.useFor: A design linting, QA or accessibility tool should show the problems it finds on a real screen.

components.name: Bento Build
components.description: A bento grid of mini feature cards builds up and spotlights tiles in turn.
components.useFor: A features overview where many capabilities need to read as one organized product.

components.name: Bracket Win
components.description: A tournament bracket resolves match by match until remocn is crowned 'CHAMPION'.
components.useFor: A launch hook framed as a competition, where the product wins every round and ends on a champion plate.

components.name: Browser Extension
components.description: A browser extension highlights article text and saves a summary to a list.
components.useFor: A browser-extension, web-clipper or AI-summarizer launch where the value is acting on the page you are already on.

components.name: Button to Card
components.description: A button expands into a store card row with product images, prices and status.
components.useFor: A storefront-builder launch beat showing how an Add item button becomes a finished product listing.

components.name: Calendar Booking
components.description: A cursor picks a time slot and a meeting-scheduled confirmation appears.
components.useFor: A scheduling or booking product beat: pick a day, pick a time, get confirmed.

components.name: Card Create
components.description: A phone app issues a yellow debit card and flips through color options.
components.useFor: A fintech launch beat showing how fast a user can issue and personalise a virtual or physical card.

components.name: Cart Add
components.description: A shop page picks a color and size, then a cart drawer slides in with Checkout.
components.useFor: An e-commerce or storefront-builder launch beat showing a product page turning into a sale.

components.name: Channel Reactions
components.description: A team chat channel where a launch message collects emoji reactions and replies.
components.useFor: A social-proof beat where a launch announcement in a team chat collects emoji reactions and replies.

components.name: Chaos to Order
components.description: Scattered windows, notes and toasts drop in, then snap into an organized issue tracker.
components.useFor: A problem-then-solution opener: too many tools and tabs, then one organized workspace.

components.name: Coupon Apply
components.description: A checkout order summary rejects a coupon, accepts another and the total drops.
components.useFor: A billing or subscription launch beat where a discount code visibly lowers the order total.

components.name: Deploy Pipeline
components.description: A deployment page runs a build, streams logs and flips to Ready.
components.useFor: A developer-platform launch beat showing a deploy going from build to Ready.

components.name: Design Audit
components.description: A full design review in one scene: redlines and issue boxes, a scan that ships the fix, a camera push into one card with specs and tokens, then layout guides.
components.useFor: A design tool, UI kit or design system launch needs a hero sequence that tells the whole review story.

components.name: Device Grows Around
components.description: A live plays counter card grows a device frame around it, with range tabs and delta stats.
components.useFor: A creator or media analytics launch that zooms out from one metric card to reveal the full app screen around it.

components.name: Feature Flag Rollout
components.description: A feature flag rolls out to 100% while error rate guardrails stay green.
components.useFor: A release-engineering beat showing a gradual rollout: toggle on, drag the percentage up, watch guardrails hold.

components.name: File Dropzone
components.description: Files drop into a knowledge base list and an upload toast confirms.
components.useFor: A document, knowledge-base or asset-management launch where upload is the first action.

components.name: Flow Builder
components.description: A workflow canvas connects nodes, branches by plan and publishes with a toast.
components.useFor: An automation or workflow-builder launch where a graph must read as buildable in seconds.

components.name: Graph Relayout
components.description: A node graph re-lays itself out to fan one prompt into voice, music and every aspect ratio.
components.useFor: A beat explaining how one prompt fans out into many outputs, with the pipeline reshaping at each step.

components.name: Grid to App
components.description: A product grid expands into a store admin app with sidebar and product catalogue.
components.useFor: A commerce-platform launch beat that zooms from a few product tiles into the full admin dashboard.

components.name: Heat Drain Reveal
components.description: A dark launch calendar cools from heat into a dithered glow and highlights the launch day.
components.useFor: A planning or scheduling product beat that ends on launch day being marked.

components.name: Home Widget
components.description: A home screen widget is added and shows a weekly renders chart above app icons.
components.useFor: A launch for an app with a home-screen widget where setup should look effortless.

components.name: Invite Team
components.description: An invite field types emails, sends invites and a toast confirms in a project list.
components.useFor: An onboarding or collaboration beat where a teammate invite is typed and sent in a few seconds.

components.name: Invoice Paid
components.description: An invoice gets stamped PAID while a payout notification arrives.
components.useFor: A finance or billing launch beat showing an invoice moving from sent to viewed to paid.

components.name: Layout Guides
components.description: Dashed column guides drop over a grid, one column fills and gets a label, a gutter is measured and a now line slides across.
components.useFor: A layout, grid or responsive feature should show the structure under a screen.

components.name: Leaderboard Climb
components.description: A launch leaderboard ranks ten products and the highlighted row climbs the table.
components.useFor: A launch recap showing the product climbing a daily ranking after a launch day push.

components.name: Live Activity
components.description: A lock-screen live activity shows a render progress bar and remaining time.
components.useFor: A launch for an app with a live status (render, delivery, deploy) that lives on the lock screen.

components.name: Live Dashboard
components.description: A payments dashboard animates its stats, chart and recent activity feed.
components.useFor: A payments or SaaS launch that needs a believable revenue dashboard with a growing chart and KPI cards.

components.name: Macro Click
components.description: A site-builder UI in macro: a cursor clicks and the page headline and hero fill in.
components.useFor: A publishing or site-builder launch where one click is the pitch.

components.name: Mobile Paywall
components.description: A phone paywall selects a plan and shows a Welcome to Pro confirmation.
components.useFor: A subscription app launch beat showing the paywall, plan pick and trial start.

components.name: Money Send
components.description: A phone payment screen confirms Sent to Maya with a receipt.
components.useFor: A fintech or payments launch beat showing how fast sending money is.

components.name: Multiplayer Cursors
components.description: Collaborator cursors drop stickies, select cards and comment on a shared board.
components.useFor: A collaboration launch beat where several named cursors work on one shared board at once.

components.name: Node Trail
components.description: A prompt node trails dotted lines into a workflow graph: script, scenes, render, publish.
components.useFor: A beat showing one typed prompt expanding into a multi-step pipeline such as script, scenes, render, publish.

components.name: Notification Avalanche
components.description: Notifications pile onto a lock screen, group into a stack, then clear to All caught up.
components.useFor: An inbox, alerts or notification-management product where the problem is overload.

components.name: Now Playing
components.description: A music player with lyrics highlights a line on a colored gradient background.
components.useFor: A music, podcast or audio-app launch where the player UI plus lyrics carry the story.

components.name: Phone Scroll
components.description: A phone app screen flicks through stops while a headline sits beside it.
components.useFor: A mobile product beat showing a long feed or page being scrolled, with a one-line promise beside the phone.

components.name: Phone Trio
components.description: Three phones side by side show a notification, a photo feed and a profile.
components.useFor: A portfolio, creator or personal-brand launch that needs profile, feed and notification in one frame.

components.name: PR Merge
components.description: A pull request is approved and merged, then its branch is deleted.
components.useFor: A developer-tool launch beat about code review: checks go green, one click merges, the status flips to Merged.

components.name: Pricing Reveal
components.description: A pricing table highlights the Pro plan and strikes the old price for the new one.
components.useFor: A pricing-page announcement where a launch discount replaces the old price.

components.name: Prompt Swell
components.description: A prompt swells into a builder that generates a pricing page with checklist and waitlist form.
components.useFor: A launch video for an AI site or page builder: prompt in, finished landing page out.

components.name: Prompt to App
components.description: A prompt types into a chat and a site preview builds as files are written.
components.useFor: A launch video for an AI app builder showing prompt, plan, file writes and the finished site in one take.

components.name: Redline Measure
components.description: Spacing and size redlines draw over a UI one by one: ticks snap in, the line grows from its middle and the value pops on.
components.useFor: A design tool, design system or UI kit launch should show that the spacing is measured, not eyeballed.

components.name: Ride Tracking
components.description: A phone map shows a driver arriving with a trip card sliding up.
components.useFor: A mobility, delivery or logistics launch where the beat is watch-it-come-to-you.

components.name: Roadmap Timeline
components.description: A project roadmap timeline drags bars and shows a reschedule toast.
components.useFor: A planning or project-management launch where rescheduling must feel effortless.

components.name: Scan Fix
components.description: A scan band sweeps down a screen: below it the old build with red redlines, above it the fixed build with blue ones, and the version chip flips.
components.useFor: A release should show the old build turning into the new one in a single sweep.

components.name: Send Fountain
components.description: A launch board dashboard fills with a video, signup bars, a metric and asset tiles.
components.useFor: A launch beat where one prompt turns into a finished dashboard filled with a video, a metric and asset tiles.

components.name: Sheet Formula
components.description: A spreadsheet formula fills a column and drops a bar chart on top.
components.useFor: A spreadsheet, analytics or no-code data product where type-once, fill-down, chart-it is the pitch.

components.name: Social Scheduler
components.description: A weekly post queue where a post is scheduled and a toast confirms.
components.useFor: A social-media management or content-scheduling launch where schedule-in-a-click is the pitch.

components.name: Status Page
components.description: A status page with uptime strips on which the cursor hovers an incident bar.
components.useFor: A reliability or infrastructure launch beat that needs to show transparent uptime history.

components.name: Stock Scrub
components.description: A phone stock page scrubs its price chart then opens a buy sheet.
components.useFor: A trading or investing app launch beat showing live price data and a quick buy.

components.name: Streak Reward
components.description: A learning app shows Lesson complete with stat badges and a Continue button.
components.useFor: A learning, fitness or habit app launch where retention is the pitch.

components.name: Swipe Deck
components.description: A swipe card deck lands an Its a match screen with an install prompt.
components.useFor: A discovery or matching app launch where swiping is the core mechanic.

components.name: Table Filter
components.description: A CRM table filters and selects rows, then a bulk-action bar slides up.
components.useFor: A CRM, database or ops-tool launch where filter, select, act is the loop to show.

components.name: Tile Snake Loader
components.description: Media tiles snake across a loader and settle into a studio landing page with a hero video card.
components.useFor: A creative-tool or studio launch that needs a loading-into-a-polished-product reveal.

components.name: Tilt Settle List
components.description: A tilted player card settles beside a ranked list of top scenes.
components.useFor: A beat that shows a player card with a ranked list of the user's most used items beside it.

components.name: Timeline Editor
components.description: A video editor with a timeline, inspector and export progress panel.
components.useFor: A video-editing or motion tool launch where the editor UI itself is the demo.

components.name: Token Tags
components.description: The rest of the UI washes out and leader lines run from elements to dark chips naming the design tokens they use.
components.useFor: A design system or theming launch should show that every color on screen comes from a named token.

components.name: Video Call
components.description: A video call shares a dashboard while participants send floating emoji reactions.
components.useFor: A team-collaboration launch beat where people join a call and one presenter shares a dashboard.

components.name: Video Watch Page
components.description: A video watch page with a player, related list and comments.
components.useFor: A video platform or creator-tool launch where social proof (views, likes, subscribers) is the payoff.

components.name: Voice Agent
components.description: A voice agent call transcript streams, handles an interruption and books a table.
components.useFor: A launch video for a voice AI product that needs to show a live call, the agent being cut off mid-sentence and a tool call completing.

components.name: Whats New Modal
components.description: A product dashboard dims behind a What is new modal with a CTA.
components.useFor: A product-update or release video where in-app announcements are the format.

components.name: Wireframe to Final
components.description: A gray wireframe dashboard resolves into the finished product UI.
components.useFor: A design or no-code launch that sells idea-to-product as one transformation.

components.name: World Signups
components.description: A dotted world map pings signup locations next to a rolling signup counter and live feed.
components.useFor: A growth beat showing signups arriving from cities around the world in real time.

components.name: ASCII Dissolve
components.description: Dissolve one scene into the next through a drifting field of ASCII glyphs.
components.useFor: The video has a retro, terminal, or print aesthetic — the text-grid dissolve reads as CRT or risograph texture.

components.name: Band Open
components.description: A horizontal band opens across the frame to reveal a landscape title card.
components.useFor: A title card reveal where one word or phrase opens up onto a photo.

components.name: Band Shift
components.description: Bright colour bands shift across the frame in a stagger to swap one scene for the next.
components.useFor: A fast swap from a short headline to a logo or closing line with a graphic, rhythmic motion.

components.name: Baton Word
components.description: A word is handed like a baton between scenes: "Film it in code." in pink and white.
components.useFor: A script-driven launch video where three or four short sentences should flow into each other word by word.

components.name: Beam Sweep
components.description: A beam of light sweeps across and reveals the next headline over a glowing horizon.
components.useFor: A beat where a working product screen gives way to a single confident statement.

components.name: Bloom Ring
components.description: A ring of light blooms outward from the Remocn mark and replaces the scene.
components.useFor: A hero beat where a headline resolves into the brand mark with an expanding burst of warm light.

components.name: Card Swipe Cover
components.description: A card swipes across and covers the frame to reveal a grid of launch-kit cards.
components.useFor: Moving from a statement headline to a catalog of deliverables, templates or case studies.

components.name: Caret Collapse
components.description: The typing caret in a prompt box collapses into the next scene.
components.useFor: A beat that moves from a typed URL or status line into an input where the viewer takes the next step.

components.name: Caret Wipe
components.description: Sweep a typing caret across the frame, wiping the outgoing scene into the next.
components.useFor: Dev-tool, editor, or terminal demos where a typing cursor is the natural through-line between scenes.

components.name: Color Bars
components.description: Slanted fluted color bars whip across the frame and swap the outgoing shot for the incoming one.
components.useFor: Cutting between two product screenshots or scenes with a bold, colorful whip.

components.name: Column Slide
components.description: Vertical columns slide in a stagger to swap one headline for another.
components.useFor: A clean, rhythmic swap between two headlines such as a plan and its launch.

components.name: Cue Word
components.description: A cue word triggers a slide, drop or lift cut to the next line on a pink ground.
components.useFor: A rapid run of short claims where each line needs its own move and one emphasized word.

components.name: Diagonal Split
components.description: A diagonal seam slides one scene away to reveal the next with a warm band.
components.useFor: A confident before-and-after swap between two statements, such as built in a weekend and launched on Monday.

components.name: Disc Pop
components.description: A disc pops open from a play button into a full video player scene.
components.useFor: Moving from typing a request into an AI tool to the finished video it produced.

components.name: Displacement
components.description: The frame breaks into a grid of cells that shear apart into offset, colour-fringed tiles under film grain, then settle back carrying the next scene.
components.useFor: A cut in a tech or interface demo should read as the picture being knocked out of register rather than blended.

components.name: Dither Dissolve
components.description: A dithering shader transition that dissolves one scene into the next.
components.useFor: The video has a retro, terminal, or print aesthetic — the dither reads as CRT/risograph texture.

components.name: Ember Burn
components.description: The outgoing frame catches fire where it is brightest, boils in the heat, chars at the rim, and blows away as sparks carrying its own colour.
components.useFor: A scene change should feel cinematic and physical — the frame is destroyed rather than blended away.

components.name: Flash Sweep
components.description: A tilted band of light sweeps across the frame and swaps one shot for the next.
components.useFor: Cutting through a chain of three or four product shots with a quick, repeated light pass.

components.name: Focus Pull
components.description: A rack-focus transition that defocuses the outgoing scene into a bright blur and resolves the next one into focus.
components.useFor: The tone is refined and editorial — premium product films, calm brand moments, testimonials.

components.name: Glitch Cut
components.description: A broadcast-glitch hard cut: the frame tears into displaced slices with channel split and corrupted blocks, and the incoming scene takes over slice by slice at the peak.
components.useFor: The cut lands in a tech or developer-facing demo and should read as a deliberate broadcast artifact instead of a smooth blend.

components.name: Grain Dissolve
components.description: A grain-gradient shader transition that disintegrates the outgoing scene into soft grainy shapes and condenses the next scene out of the noise.
components.useFor: The video has an editorial, textured, analog feel — grain reads as film and print.

components.name: Grid Wave
components.description: A wave travels across the frame raising the picture into a grid of solid blocks with lit tops and shaded sides, which set back down carrying the next scene.
components.useFor: A product or interface demo needs a cut with craft — the frame is handled as a surface rather than blended away.

components.name: Hairline Open
components.description: A hairline of light opens like a slit onto the next serif statement.
components.useFor: A calm, editorial swap between two statements, such as a plan and its result.

components.name: Halftone Cut
components.description: A halftone dot pattern cuts one headline into the next on a warm gradient.
components.useFor: A print-flavored swap between two headlines, such as a draft and a final version.

components.name: Hot Slab Morph
components.description: A hot-coloured slab morphs into a prompt card under the line "or just describe it".
components.useFor: A beat that moves from choosing a template to describing a video in your own words.

components.name: Hyperspace
components.description: A deterministic starfield stretches into radial streaks, the scene tunnels forward and a white flash at the cut reveals the next scene.
components.useFor: A launch, release or "what's next" moment should feel like a jump to somewhere new.

components.name: Icon Scatter
components.description: Scatter a field of icons over the cut, hiding the scene swap at the field's peak.
components.useFor: Playful product or app transitions where icons are part of the brand's visual language.

components.name: Iris Wipe
components.description: An old-cartoon iris closes on the subject, holds a beat as a dot, then opens on the next scene.
components.useFor: You want an old-cartoon "that's all" beat: the iris closes on a subject, lingers, and reopens somewhere new.

components.name: Lens Zoom
components.description: A hard cut disguised as a lens punch-in: barrel distortion, zoom blur, chromatic split and camera shake around the splice.
components.useFor: A high-energy beat drop or reveal needs a cinematic camera move — the cut hides inside the peak of the distortion.

components.name: Letter Gate
components.description: The camera pushes into a giant letter pair, the gap opens like a gate onto the next scene.
components.useFor: A launch video where a call-to-action headline hands off to a prompt or editor screen with a match cut on its own letters.

components.name: Light Burn to Line
components.description: Light burns the scene down to a line that opens onto "Now ship your first film.".
components.useFor: A closing beat where a busy product screen should resolve into one calm line and a call to action.

components.name: Light Leak
components.description: A warm analog light leak drifts in from an edge and blows the frame out to near-white at the cut, then cools off to reveal the next scene.
components.useFor: The video has a film, lifestyle or nostalgic look and the cut should feel like light hitting the negative.

components.name: Page Turn
components.description: The exiting scene swings up and away like a notebook page in stop-motion poses, staying above the scene it reveals.
components.useFor: Act breaks in paper or scrapbook stop-motion videos — the current page physically leaves and the next scene is already living beneath it.

components.name: Paper Tear
components.description: A jagged rip runs down the frame, then both halves peel apart on a spring with white fibrous torn edges, revealing the scene underneath.
components.useFor: A reveal should land as a physical hit: a product, a headline or a price punching through the old scene.

components.name: Particle Dissolve
components.description: The frame is ground into drifting grey dust whose specks carry real fragments of the picture, and the next scene coalesces back out of the same dust.
components.useFor: A scene change should read as the picture breaking down into matter and reassembling, not as one image fading through another.

components.name: Perlin Dissolve
components.description: A perlin-noise shader transition that sweeps its noise threshold to dissolve one scene into the next.
components.useFor: Organic, atmospheric chapter changes — nature, ambient, calm product films.

components.name: Pixel Sort
components.description: The scene melts into seeded vertical streaks like glitch-art pixel sorting, then the next scene's columns fall in and snap into place.
components.useFor: The video has a glitch, generative or data-art look and the cut should feel like the image is being processed.

components.name: Press Warp Dive
components.description: A button press warps and dives into a video player, landing on the next scene.
components.useFor: An AI-prompt product demo where typing a request and hitting send should visibly launch the generated result.

components.name: Push Through
components.description: A dolly transition that blows the outgoing scene past the camera while the next one approaches from the depth.
components.useFor: The narrative moves deeper into a topic — zooming in on a feature, entering a product, chapter descent.

components.name: Replay Wipe
components.description: Broadcast-style replay wipes cut between two shots under a LIVE frame.
components.useFor: A sports or event style recap in a launch video, cutting from a live moment to its replay.

components.name: Ring Burst
components.description: A glowing ring bursts outward from a point and reveals the next scene.
components.useFor: Swapping a short headline for a logo or closing statement with a punchy, centered burst.

components.name: Ring Cut
components.description: A circular cut expands from a chosen origin to swap one scene for the next.
components.useFor: Swapping a short statement for a logo or closing line with a circular reveal from a chosen point.

components.name: Ripple Zoom
components.description: A grain-gradient ripple transition that flies the camera through the center of the rings while the next scene approaches from the depth.
components.useFor: A hero statement or logo deserves a camera move — the dolly-through-rings reads as arriving at the point.

components.name: Shader Seam
components.description: Dissolve a stationary OpenShaders material to uncover the next scene.
components.useFor: An OpenShaders material should dissolve in place to reveal the next scene.

components.name: Shader Spiral Pass
components.description: Accelerate into the hero spiral and emerge through its soft center into the next scene.
components.useFor: A scene change should feel like flying through the center of a luminous spiral.

components.name: Shape Cut
components.description: A circle, square or pill grows from the text and cuts to the next scene with the logo.
components.useFor: Swapping a short statement for a logo or closing line with a single bold shape that ends as a punctuation-like mark.

components.name: Slide Swap
components.description: A scene sequencer where the outgoing content is shoved off on an accelerating curve and the next springs in from the opposite edge, on one canvas, with no overlap.
components.useFor: You want a scene-to-scene grammar with no overlap at all — the outgoing content is fully gone before the incoming content's first frame.

components.name: Slit Reveal
components.description: A point of light draws a hairline that opens onto a product scene, with a glow ring below.
components.useFor: Introducing a product with a title that rides a line of light before the screen is revealed.

components.name: Smoke Dissolve
components.description: A smoke-ring shader transition that expands the ring outward to reveal the next scene.
components.useFor: A reveal should feel like emerging from mist — moody, cinematic, mysterious openings.

components.name: Spring Settle
components.description: A scene sequencer where the outgoing scene shrinks away as one group, the stage holds empty for a beat, and the next scene's items land staggered from above-1 scale.
components.useFor: The stage colour changes from scene to scene — the crossfade happens inside the empty gap, so it never muddies two scenes together.

components.name: Strobe Montage
components.description: A fast strobe montage of frames flickers between two scenes, landing on a prompt box.
components.useFor: A high-energy cut from an opening claim to the product prompt, with a burst of imagery in between.

components.name: Swirl Dissolve
components.description: A swirl shader transition that unwinds open and winds shut to reveal the next scene.
components.useFor: A dramatic chapter break where the frame should visibly transform — reveals, act changes.

components.name: Tile Wave
components.description: A wave of tiles flips across the frame, swapping headline for scene on a stage.
components.useFor: Swapping a short statement for a result or outcome word, such as Idea to Shipped, with a tactile grid motion.

components.name: Venetian Blinds
components.description: The outgoing scene splits into horizontal slats that turn edge-on in a staggered ripple, revealing the next scene behind them.
components.useFor: You want a graphic, editorial cut with visible structure, like a magazine spread or a brand reel.

components.name: Warp Dissolve
components.description: A domain-warp shader transition that melts the outgoing scene into a folding color field and straightens back out into the next.
components.useFor: Moving between chapters or moods — the melt reads as time passing or context shifting.

components.name: Wave Wipe
components.description: A grain-gradient wave that sweeps up across the frame, covering the outgoing scene and revealing the next one from below.
components.useFor: The transition should feel like physical motion — a swell washing over the frame, tides, page-over-page.

components.name: Whip Pan
components.description: A whip-pan transition that flies both scenes through the frame in one move with velocity-based motion blur.
components.useFor: Cuts need to feel fast and energetic — feature-to-feature jumps, montage rhythm, tech demos.

components.name: Window Trail
components.description: An orange window sweeps over 'Old look.' and leaves 'New look, same product.' behind it.
components.useFor: A before-and-after beat such as an old look versus a new look, or a rename or rebrand.

components.name: Zoom Blur
components.description: A depth punch-in transition that pushes the outgoing scene through the viewer while the incoming one resolves out of blur.
components.useFor: You need a default, general-purpose cut for a product demo — the de-facto workhorse transition of the catalog.

components.name: Achievement Pop
components.description: Stacked achievement toasts unlock one by one, the last a rare gradient-filled card.
components.useFor: A milestones or gamification beat showing a user unlocking several achievements in sequence.

components.name: Animated Bar Chart
components.description: Bars spring up from the baseline in a staggered cascade.
components.useFor: Showing comparative categorical metrics in a product demo — feature usage, plan distribution, benchmark scores.

components.name: Animated Line Chart
components.description: Line chart whose SVG path draws on from left to right with a leading dot.
components.useFor: Showing growth or trend over time — revenue curve, DAU climb, error-rate drop.

components.name: Border Beam
components.description: A beam laps the border of a dark card, then reveals 'remocn 2.0' with a logo and description.
components.useFor: A version or release announcement card that should feel premium and lit from the edge.

components.name: Card Fan
components.description: Colourful format cards fan out of a stack with a "Your top formats" caption.
components.useFor: Presenting a handful of formats, templates or plans as a hand of cards with one highlighted.

components.name: Card Push Line
components.description: A prompt card with a slash command pushes forward as its text line types.
components.useFor: An AI product beat that pairs a short headline with the prompt box it describes, such as a promise followed by proof.

components.name: Caret Dolly
components.description: A prompt box types a request while the camera dollies along the caret.
components.useFor: An AI product launch where the typed prompt is the hero, with one phrase emphasized in extreme close-up.

components.name: Check List
components.description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out in full, then ticks and strikes through every done item, one at a time.
components.useFor: A list of features, steps, or done-items should be read in full and then crossed off in a hand-made scene.

components.name: Code Morph
components.description: A flat code editor that morphs between versions of a file, gliding each surviving token to its new line and column while removed code dissolves and new code fades in.
components.useFor: A launch or product demo needs to show an API getting simpler, with the before and after code in one panel and the surviving tokens visibly traveling to their new places.

components.name: Drop Upload
components.description: A file card drops in and fills an upload bar until a check confirms it.
components.useFor: A feature beat about importing a document, with the full drop, progress and success arc.

components.name: Ghost Complete
components.description: Grey ghost suggestions autocomplete a sentence, each accepted with a Tab keypress.
components.useFor: An AI autocomplete or writing-assistant feature where the suggestion appears as ghost text before being accepted.

components.name: Glass Code Block
components.description: A premium frosted-glass code editor window with a regex tokenizer and line-by-line stagger reveal.
components.useFor: A landing or hero scene needs an animated code backdrop that reads as "premium dev tool."

components.name: Glass Code Walk
components.description: A camera that scans a glass code block top to bottom as it types, then pulls back to a centered hold.
components.useFor: A code reveal needs camera motion — the frame stays pinned to the line currently typing, then pulls back so the whole file lands as the payoff.

components.name: Glow Born Card
components.description: A glow condenses into an "Import from repository" dialog beside split headline text.
components.useFor: A feature beat introducing an import or connect flow, where the headline splits open to make room for the dialog.

components.name: Keycap Press
components.description: Two 3D keycaps press Cmd and K under the line Everything, one shortcut away.
components.useFor: A shortcut or command-palette feature, such as a two-key chord that opens everything.

components.name: Launch Days
components.description: Vertical day tabs expand one into a big card, '03 Templates', under a Launch Week header.
components.useFor: A launch-week announcement where one day is spotlighted among a week of upcoming features.

components.name: Macro Tab Name
components.description: A macro-zoomed tab chip reads "Launch Assets" as a cursor moves in and clicks.
components.useFor: A feature beat about naming or renaming a document, project or workspace, shot as an extreme close-up of the tab.

components.name: Menu Pick
components.description: A choose-your-launch menu dims two options and highlights the third on a red bar.
components.useFor: A choose-your-path beat where the answer is obviously the last option, such as three ways to ship a launch.

components.name: Multi File Drop
components.description: Files drop into a prompt box as chips, then a cursor presses send.
components.useFor: An AI or builder product that takes a prompt plus attachments, shown as several files dropped in at once.

components.name: Paper Sticker
components.description: A taped paper chip that slaps onto the scene over two stop-motion poses, keeping a hand-placed tilt and per-pose wobble.
components.useFor: Short labels, chips, or callout notes should exist as physical taped paper on a stop-motion scene.

components.name: Pill Morph
components.description: A logo pill opens into a product card, splits into feature pills and becomes an app tile.
components.useFor: A product intro that goes from brand mark to product window to feature list to app icon in one continuous shape.

components.name: Polaroid
components.description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption for video, images, or live compositions.
components.useFor: Media belongs in a hand-placed instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption.

components.name: Query Cascade
components.description: Search queries rush past until the hero query lands and its answer line resolves.
components.useFor: A search or answer-engine launch showing the one question that matters among many.

components.name: Reel
components.description: A fixed centered card where images stack on the z-axis and each blooms open over the last via a centre-out mask.
components.useFor: Showing a sequence of screenshots or product shots that should bloom open one over the last in a fixed frame.

components.name: Rim Draw Card
components.description: A settings card gets its rim drawn in light, revealing a brand-voice toggle and text field.
components.useFor: A feature beat about saving reusable instructions or a custom skill, shown as a card that builds itself.

components.name: Rotary Dial
components.description: A knurled dial turns to 10 while its arc heats up and 10x render speed counts up.
components.useFor: A performance or intensity claim such as render speed going from 1 to 10.

components.name: Search Reveal
components.description: Expanding construction circles snap into a search pill, type editable text, and reveal an abstract graphic panel.
components.useFor: A product introduction should begin with a search for its name.

components.name: Terminal Cursor Zoom
components.description: Camera locked to the typing cursor, dollying across a terminal as a command types at high zoom.
components.useFor: One install command is the whole beat and it must stay legible in a vertical or small-screen crop — the camera holds the cursor at frame center at 2.8× zoom.

components.name: Terminal Simulator
components.description: Terminal window that types out commands and rolls old lines off the top.
components.useFor: Demoing a CLI tool install sequence (`npm install`, `npx shadcn add`, build output).

components.name: Toggle on
components.description: A large switch flips on and lights the stage as the Auto-captions label turns On.
components.useFor: A feature beat about a single setting being enabled, such as auto-captions or dark mode.

components.name: Toolbar Unfurl
components.description: A round tap button unfurls into a tool strip while captions list each tool over a glowing ribbon.
components.useFor: A feature beat introducing a set of editor tools, one caption per tool, such as select, text, draw and comment.

components.name: UI Callout
components.description: Callout cards route to targets on a product screen with connecting leader lines.
