components.useFor: Explaining three or so parts of a screen, each with a short title and body.

components.name: URL Bar CTA
components.description: A browser window with a landing page where the cursor clicks the Get started button.
components.useFor: A call-to-action beat that ends on a web address and the page it opens.

components.name: Caption Active Pop
components.description: The word being spoken turns to the accent colour and springs up in scale, then settles back as the voice moves on.
components.useFor: A talking head or voiceover needs the everyday short-form caption look — the full phrase on screen with the spoken word lifting out of it.

components.name: Caption Blur In
components.description: Each word resolves out of a soft blur the moment it is spoken, for captions that arrive quietly.
components.useFor: Calm narration, a product film or a launch video where the captions should feel considered rather than loud — words come into focus instead of jumping in.

components.name: Caption Bounce In
components.description: Each word springs up into place with a little overshoot the moment it is spoken, and the phrase builds word by word.
components.useFor: Short-form video with an energetic voice — each word lands with a small hop, so the captions feel as lively as the delivery.

components.name: Caption Cube
components.description: Each new phrase turns into view as the next face of a 3D cube, the previous phrase rotating up and away on a horizontal hinge.
components.useFor: Punchy social or explainer video where each phrase change should feel like a physical beat — the caption turns over with the speaker instead of swapping.

components.name: Caption Dim Progress
components.description: The whole phrase sits on screen dimmed and each word brightens the moment it is spoken, with no motion at all.
components.useFor: Captions have to be read rather than watched — tutorials, explainers, accessibility-first edits where nothing should move.

components.name: Caption Drop
components.description: Each word falls into place from above and bounces as it lands the moment it is spoken, and the whole phrase drops out of frame when the speaker pauses.
components.useFor: Short-form or playful video where the captions should have weight — words land with a bounce and a slight tilt that settles, like they were dropped onto the line.

components.name: Caption Emoji
components.description: An emoji pops up above a chosen word the moment it is spoken and stays until the phrase leaves.
components.useFor: Short-form social video where a few words deserve a visual punchline — an emoji lands on the beat the word is said.

components.name: Caption Handwrite
components.description: Each word is inked in by hand from left to right at the pace it is spoken, every word sitting at its own slight angle.
components.useFor: A personal, journal-like video — vlog, founder story, voice memo — where the captions should feel written by the speaker rather than typeset.

components.name: Caption Highlight Box
components.description: A solid box travels behind the word being spoken, sliding from word to word as the voice moves on.
components.useFor: Short-form video where the caption has to be read at a glance — a solid block behind the spoken word is the loudest way to say where the voice is.

components.name: Caption Karaoke
components.description: Transcript captions where each word fills with colour left to right exactly as it is spoken, the whole phrase readable before the voice reaches it.
components.useFor: A voiceover or talking head needs captions and the viewer should be able to read ahead — the full phrase is on screen, the fill only shows where the voice is.

components.name: Caption Knockout
components.description: A solid plate with the words cut clean through it, each word punching out the moment it is spoken so the footage shows through the letters.
components.useFor: The footage is worth seeing and you want the caption to frame it rather than cover it — the letters are windows onto whatever plays behind them.

components.name: Caption Label Maker
components.description: Each phrase is punched letter by letter into a strip of embossing tape at the pace it is spoken, the tape feeding out as the words arrive.
components.useFor: A handmade, analog or DIY video wants captions with a physical object behind them — the tape is the legibility, so it reads over any footage.

components.name: Caption Marker
components.description: Plain captions where the words that matter get a highlighter swipe the moment they are spoken.
components.useFor: Talking-head or explainer video where a few words carry the point — the marker lands on exactly those words, in time with the voice, and leaves the rest calm.

components.name: Caption Outline
components.description: Heavy-stroked captions that stay readable over any footage, with the spoken word switching to a contrast colour and nothing else moving.
components.useFor: Captions sit over busy, bright or fast-cut footage — the thick outline keeps every word readable without a plate or a shadow.

components.name: Caption Prosody
components.description: Word size follows the delivery, so drawn-out words land large and rushed words stay small, and the rhythm of the voice is visible with the sound off.
components.useFor: The way something is said matters as much as what is said — a slow, stretched word reads as emphasis and a quick aside shrinks, so the captions carry the speaker's rhythm without audio.

components.name: Caption Redact
components.description: The whole phrase starts blacked out like a declassified file, and each bar pulls away the moment its word is spoken.
components.useFor: Investigative, true-crime or reveal-style storytelling where the line should feel withheld until the speaker says it out loud.

components.name: Caption Rise
components.description: Each word slides up out of a mask at its baseline the moment it is spoken, with no bounce and no scale.
components.useFor: Editorial video, interviews or a brand film where the captions should feel typeset — words rise into a fixed line with a confident ease-out and nothing extra.

components.name: Caption Scramble
components.description: Each word arrives as random glyphs at the moment it is spoken and decodes left to right into the real letters.
components.useFor: The video is about software, security, AI or data and the captions should feel like a terminal decoding the voice as it speaks.

components.name: Caption Slice
components.description: Each word arrives cut in two, the top half sliding in from the left and the bottom from the right, locking together the moment it is spoken.
components.useFor: Tech, product or launch video where the captions should feel engineered — every word assembles itself on cue instead of fading in.

components.name: Caption Slot
components.description: One short line at a time, each new phrase rolling up into place as the previous one rolls out the top.
components.useFor: Fast talking-head or social video where the caption should keep moving with the speaker without words animating individually.

components.name: Caption Speaker
components.description: Dialogue captions where every phrase takes its speaker's colour, so a conversation reads like a script.
components.useFor: An interview, podcast clip or two-person demo where the viewer has to know who is talking without seeing their mouth.

components.name: Caption Split Flap
components.description: Every letter sits on its own flap tile and clatters through a few characters before landing the moment the word is spoken, like a station departure board.
components.useFor: A launch, travel or tech video wants a mechanical, announcement-board feel — each word arrives as tiles flipping into place on cue.

components.name: Caption Stack
components.description: Kinetic captions stacked a couple of words per line, with the keyword of each page set large on its own line.
components.useFor: Short-form video where the captions are part of the design — each page reads as a small typographic poster, and the word that matters is the biggest thing on it.

components.name: Caption Stamp
components.description: Plain captions where the words that matter slam down as a rubber stamp the moment they are spoken.
components.useFor: A punchy explainer or reaction video where one word per phrase should land with impact — the stamp hits on exactly that word, in time with the voice.

components.name: Caption Subtitle
components.description: Classic broadcast subtitles, a whole phrase on a translucent plate, with no word-level animation at all.
components.useFor: Explainers, interviews and talking heads where the captions should be read, not watched — the accessibility-first option.

components.name: Caption Teleprompter
components.description: The whole transcript scrolls smoothly through a short window with the current line centred, past lines fading above and the next line waiting below.
components.useFor: The speech is long and continuous — an explainer, a talk, a narrated walkthrough — and the viewer benefits from seeing the line before and the line after.

components.name: Caption Timeline
components.description: The whole transcript laid out on a scrolling time strip that slides under a fixed playhead, so every pause shows up as space between words.
components.useFor: The video is about audio, editing or timing — a podcast clip, a voice tool, a recording workflow — and the captions should look like a track being played back.

components.name: Caption Typewriter
components.description: Each word types out character by character at the pace it is spoken, with a caret that blinks while the speaker pauses.
components.useFor: A voiceover walks through a terminal, an editor or a technical product, and the captions should feel typed rather than printed.

components.name: Caption Underline
components.description: A bar slides under the word being spoken, travelling from word to word while the text itself stays untouched.
components.useFor: You want to show where the voice is with the lightest possible mark — the words keep their colour and only a thin bar moves beneath them.

components.name: Caption Weight
components.description: The word being spoken swells from a light weight to a heavy one and relaxes as the voice moves on, with no layout shift.
components.useFor: You want captions that follow the voice with typography alone — no colour change, no box, just the active word gaining weight.

components.name: Caption Word Pop
components.description: One large word at a time, each popping in on a spring the moment it is spoken.
components.useFor: Punchy short-form talking heads where every word should hit — one word fills the centre of the frame and the next replaces it on the beat.

components.name: ASCII Render
components.description: Redraw a live scene as ASCII: the frame divides into glyph cells and each one becomes the character matching the brightness of the picture inside it.
components.useFor: A scene should arrive out of text — interpolate intensity from 1 to 0 and the UI resolves out of ASCII instead of just fading in.

components.name: Camera Lens
components.description: Put a scene behind real glass: resolution falls off toward the corners, highlights bloom through the optics, colour fringes at the edges — a screencast that reads as filmed rather than rendered.
components.useFor: A screencast looks sterile and you want it to read as filmed — this is the cheapest way to stop a recording looking like a render.

components.name: CRT Screen
components.description: Put a scene behind curved glass: the picture bulges out to the corners, an RGB phosphor mask and scanlines ride the curve, bright areas flood the mask, and the tube falls away into darkness at the rim.
components.useFor: A scene should read as something displayed on a tube rather than rendered flat — retro terminals, arcade beats, an old dashboard being demoed.

components.name: Halftone Print
components.description: Print a scene onto paper: each colour separates onto its own rotated screen of dots sized by the ink under them, slightly out of register the way a real press runs.
components.useFor: A scene should read as something printed rather than displayed — zine-flavoured intros, riso posters, editorial title cards.

components.name: Hologram
components.description: Play a scene as a projection: a ghost double shimmers off the image, emission lines structure it, and only what is bright enough carries through the dark volume it hangs in.
components.useFor: A feature should present as a projection rather than as a screen — a sci-fi flavoured reveal, a 'here is what is coming' beat.

components.name: Pixelate Region
components.description: Cover rectangles of a scene with an opaque mosaic while the rest passes through untouched — redact keys, addresses and personal data before a demo goes out.
components.useFor: A product demo shows real data — API keys, tokens, email addresses, account numbers — that must not leave the building.

components.name: Security Cam
components.description: Run a scene through a cheap recorder: macroblocks flatten under a starved bitrate, colour resolution collapses to half the luma, blacks crush and shadows crawl with sensor noise.
components.useFor: A beat should play as surveillance footage — a cold open, a 'meanwhile, in production' aside, anything that wants to read as captured rather than presented.

components.name: Sustained Glitch
components.description: Broadcast corruption held over a scene in scheduled bursts: slices tear sideways, channels split, and blocks fill with picture pulled from somewhere else — then the frame rests clean until the next hit.
components.useFor: A tech or developer-facing scene should feel unstable for its whole run without the corruption ever settling into a constant texture.

components.name: Underwater Ripple
components.description: Hold a scene under moving water: every pixel is read through a layered refraction field that closes on a whole number of cycles, with colour fringing where the water bends hardest.
components.useFor: A scene should sit under water for its whole run — calm premium backdrops, ambient hero loops, a title card that needs motion without a direction.

components.name: VHS Filter
components.description: Hold a scene under analog tape: chroma bleeds sideways off every edge, rows wobble out of line, the bottom of the frame tears on the head switch, and luma noise settles over all of it.
components.useFor: A scene should read as recovered tape footage rather than a clean render — retro product spots, 'here is what we shipped in 2003' beats, lo-fi title cards.

components.name: Shader Caustics
components.description: A field of refracted light — the bright filaments light makes through a rippling surface.
components.useFor: Water, light, or premium ambient backdrops where refracted-light filaments fit the mood.

components.name: Shader Color Panels
components.description: Overlapping translucent color panels sliding past each other.
components.useFor: You want an architectural, glassy backdrop of translucent panes sliding past each other.

components.name: Shader Dithering
components.description: Ordered-dither shading over an animated gradient field.
components.useFor: You want a retro/print, 1-bit ordered-dither texture over a moving gradient.

components.name: Shader Dot Orbit
components.description: Dots orbiting on concentric paths across the frame.
components.useFor: You want a structured dot-grid backdrop with gentle orbital motion.

components.name: Shader Gem Smoke
components.description: Paper's Gem Smoke shader driven by the frame — smoke flowing behind and inside a glassy logo.
components.useFor: Brand or logo reveals that want smoke living inside and around a mark.

components.name: Shader God Rays
components.description: Volumetric light rays radiating from an off-screen source.
components.useFor: A hero or reveal scene wants cinematic volumetric light rays from a corner source.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient
components.description: Grainy multi-stop gradient that drifts slowly with film-grain texture over the blend.
components.useFor: A gradient backdrop needs analog texture — the grain reads as film/print rather than flat digital.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Arcade
components.description: Retro grainy dots in orange, yellow and green on black.
components.useFor: A retro, game-like intro with bold color dots.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Blush
components.description: Pastel pink and apricot blob morphing on warm off-white.
components.useFor: A soft, friendly scene for consumer or creator products.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Dune
components.description: Sandy grain wave in tan, caramel and rust.
components.useFor: An earthy, analog scene with heavy sand-like grain.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Horizon
components.description: Peach horizon band rolling between navy and pale sky.
components.useFor: A wide landscape mood with a warm band across the middle of the frame.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Nebula
components.description: Magenta and cyan glow blooming from the corners of deep space.
components.useFor: A cosmic, mysterious intro for AI or space-themed products.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Orb
components.description: Large grainy sphere in periwinkle, violet and pink.
components.useFor: A single glowing object behind a centered title or logo.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Sunrise
components.description: Grainy wave of coral and gold rising over a plum night.
components.useFor: A rising, hopeful moment such as a launch day or a new chapter.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Tide
components.description: Teal ripple ring pulsing out of a dark sea-green core.
components.useFor: A pulsing, sonar-like ring behind a centered stat or logo.

components.name: Shader Grain Gradient Ultraviolet
components.description: Electric magenta and blue blob morphing on ultraviolet black.
components.useFor: A loud, electric hero for a bold launch or a music-style edit.

components.name: Light Tunnel
components.description: Fly straight through a tunnel made from the original OpenShaders hero shader.
components.useFor: A title reveal or product intro needs a luminous forward flight through a tunnel.

components.name: Shader Liquid Metal
components.description: Molten metallic surface with flowing specular highlights.
components.useFor: A premium, industrial, or luxury scene wants a brushed/molten metal surface.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient
components.description: WebGL mesh gradient backdrop driven per-frame for deterministic Remotion renders.
components.useFor: You need a quality, production-grade gradient backdrop.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Aurora
components.description: Cyan and violet ribbons swirling out of a near-black sky.
components.useFor: A night-sky backdrop for AI, data or developer-tool launches.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Dusk
components.description: Violet dusk with coral and peach light drifting through deep indigo.
components.useFor: An evening, end-of-day mood behind a launch title or a closing card.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Ember
components.description: Molten orange and amber pooling in dark oxblood.
components.useFor: A bold, warm hero for an announcement that should feel energetic.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Ink
components.description: Monochrome ink folds in charcoal and silver with grain.
components.useFor: A monochrome, editorial backdrop that lets a colored product shot lead.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Lagoon
components.description: Bright aqua and teal shallows with a deep-blue undertow.
components.useFor: A fresh, bright product intro that should feel calm and open.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Lavender
components.description: Soft lilac and pink haze with grain-softened edges.
components.useFor: A gentle, dreamy title card that should stay quiet behind copy.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Mint
components.description: Airy mint and sky-blue pastel wash around a deeper green core.
components.useFor: A fresh health, finance or productivity intro on a light palette.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Peach
components.description: Warm peach and cream glow with a whisper of film grain.
components.useFor: A warm, friendly lifestyle or wellness scene with soft film texture.

components.name: Shader Mesh Gradient Synthwave
components.description: Night-purple field lit by a warm coral sunset glow.
components.useFor: A dark, retro-futuristic scene with a warm glow at one edge.

components.name: Shader Metaballs
components.description: Organic blobs merging and splitting like lava.
components.useFor: A playful or organic scene wants lava-lamp blobs merging and splitting.

components.name: Shader Neuro Noise
components.description: Organic neural-web noise field that slowly morphs.
components.useFor: An AI / ML / tech scene wants an organic neural-web texture that reads as "intelligence".

components.name: Shader Perlin Noise
components.description: Classic Perlin noise clouds drifting across the frame.
components.useFor: You want a soft, cloudy, organic backdrop that drifts slowly and stays calm.

components.name: Shader Pulsing Border
components.description: Glowing border frame that pulses around the edges.
components.useFor: You want a pulsing lit frame around the scene edges to contain foreground content.

components.name: Shader Simplex Noise
components.description: Simplex noise flow field, smoother than Perlin.
components.useFor: You want the smoothest of the noise backdrops — fewer directional artifacts than Perlin.

components.name: Shader Smoke Ring
components.description: Soft smoke ring curling and dissipating in place.
components.useFor: You want a single soft, centered smoke ring as a focal atmospheric element.

components.name: Shader Spiral
components.description: Rotating spiral arms radiating from the center.
components.useFor: You want a hypnotic, rotating radial background with visible arm structure.

components.name: Shader Strata
components.description: Fine horizontal sediment layers displaced by fbm noise, each drifting at its own depth.
components.useFor: Calm, grounded, geological ambient backdrops — foundations, stability, "built on" narratives.

components.name: Shader Swirl
components.description: Concentric bands swirling around a center point.
components.useFor: You want a hypnotic, radial background with clear banded structure around a center.

components.name: Shader Swirl Candy
components.description: Pastel pink, lilac and sky-blue spiral, soft and sweet.
components.useFor: A sweet, pastel opener for a playful consumer product.

components.name: Shader Swirl Citrus
components.description: Juicy yellow, pink and green bands spiralling on cream.
components.useFor: A juicy, upbeat opener with bold summer colors.

components.name: Shader Swirl Ember
components.description: Gold and orange fire bands spinning around a dark core.
components.useFor: A fiery vortex for an intense, energetic beat.

components.name: Shader Swirl Hypno
components.description: High-contrast black and white hypnotic spiral.
components.useFor: A high-contrast, hypnotic beat that pulls the eye to the center.

components.name: Shader Swirl Lilac
components.description: Dreamy lilac and baby-blue swirl around a dark eye.
components.useFor: A dreamy, soft swirl that stays out of the way of copy.

components.name: Shader Swirl Neon
components.description: Neon teal, purple and pink vortex around a dark core.
components.useFor: A neon vortex behind a centered logo reveal.

components.name: Shader Swirl Retro
components.description: Seventies spiral in orange, sand and teal.
components.useFor: A seventies-style spiral for a vintage or nostalgic edit.

components.name: Shader Swirl Sunburst
components.description: Retro cream and orange bands sweeping in from above.
components.useFor: A retro, sunny burst sweeping in behind a title.

components.name: Shader Swirl Tide
components.description: Silky blue bands twisting into a deep navy whirlpool.
components.useFor: A calm, silky whirlpool that feels deep rather than loud.

components.name: Shader Voronoi
components.description: Animated Voronoi cells shifting and re-tessellating.
components.useFor: You want a cellular, crystalline backdrop that shifts and re-tessellates.

components.name: Shader Warp
components.description: Domain-warped color field that folds and stretches like liquid.
components.useFor: A hero scene wants organic, liquid motion that feels alive but stays out of the way.

components.name: Shader Warp Acid
components.description: Loud lime and cyan fluid swirling over black.
components.useFor: A loud, attention-grabbing beat or a quick hype cut.

components.name: Shader Warp Cream
components.description: Soft peach-to-coral cream gradient with a gentle drift.
components.useFor: A barely-moving warm backdrop behind dense text or UI.

components.name: Shader Warp Deep Sea
components.description: Diagonal teal bands rippling through midnight blue.
components.useFor: A rhythmic, banded background with steady directional motion.

components.name: Shader Warp Marble
components.description: Cream and charcoal marble veins swirling together.
components.useFor: An editorial, material-like backdrop in neutral cream and charcoal.

components.name: Shader Warp Ocean
components.description: Glossy aqua currents traced with dark ink edges.
components.useFor: A glossy, high-contrast fluid scene with crisp dark edges.

components.name: Shader Warp Rose Gold
components.description: Satin rose-gold folds with a soft sheen.
components.useFor: A soft satin backdrop for beauty, fashion or lifestyle products.

components.name: Shader Warp Silk
components.description: Violet and pink liquid silk folding in slow waves.
components.useFor: A luxurious, soft-motion hero for a premium brand moment.

components.name: Shader Warp Storm
components.description: Deep violet and lavender storm of marbled fluid.
components.useFor: A dramatic, turbulent intro in deep violet.

components.name: Shader Warp Sunset
components.description: Marbled coral, peach and wine flowing like warm liquid.
components.useFor: A warm, liquid backdrop that feels alive without hard edges.

components.name: Shader Water
components.description: Caustic water-surface ripples with subtle refraction.
components.useFor: A scene wants a calm, aquatic atmosphere with gentle refracted highlights.

components.name: Shader Weave
components.description: A woven substrate of warp and weft threads crossing on a domain-warped grid, with a travelling sheen.
components.useFor: Tactile, crafted, "made-of" textures — fabric, mesh, or substrate metaphors.

components.name: a to Z
components.description: An alphabet gag where a big "Z" and "is for zero lock-in." land on orange.
components.useFor: A feature-list beat framed as an alphabet, where each item starts with the next letter and the finale lands on Z.

components.name: Absorb Stack
components.description: A centred stack of small lines, ending in a red "on top.", on a dark brown ground.
components.useFor: A short poetic statement set as a centered stack of lines in a brand film.

components.name: Acronym Expand
components.description: An acronym expands letter by letter into 'Model Context Protocol' with an eyebrow and subhead.
components.useFor: A feature-naming beat where a short acronym like MCP or SDK needs to be spelled out for the viewer.

components.name: Anagram Shuffle
components.description: Letters of one word slide into new positions to spell its anagram.
components.useFor: A clever hook where two related words share the same letters, such as a product's before and after.

components.name: and You
components.description: A list of audiences ("For the founder who...") ends on a big "and you.".
components.useFor: A who-it's-for beat that lists several audiences and ends by addressing the viewer.

components.name: Answer First
components.description: The question "Who made this video?" is answered by a big "A pull request.".
components.useFor: A Q&A beat where the punchy answer should land before the question that explains it.

components.name: Aspect Slit
components.description: A film-title card opens through a slit, with a serif hero line and a small caption.
components.useFor: A film-style title card for a product launch or release announcement.

components.name: Axis Flex
components.description: A gradient word flexes its width and weight like an elastic variable font.
components.useFor: A beat about flexibility or range, where a single word shows off a variable font's width and weight.

components.name: Baseline Drop
components.description: Words drop onto the baseline in a stagger, with a gradient streak beneath.
components.useFor: A closing tagline where each word should land with weight, one beat after another.

components.name: Beam Split
components.description: A light beam splits a bold headline and a serif italic phrase appears in the gap.
components.useFor: A headline that sets up a punchline, where the second phrase appears inside the opened gap.

components.name: Beta Thanks
components.description: "Remocn is out" with a green "out", thanking the beta testers below.
components.useFor: A thanks-to-testers or early-access closing beat in a release video.

components.name: Block Swap
components.description: A block overwrites each line with the next, ending 'Render the launch.' on a gradient pill.
components.useFor: A beat that rewrites one statement into another, such as a problem line replaced by the answer.

components.name: Blur Out Up
components.description: Words arrive clean and depart upward with increasing blur for airy exits.
components.useFor: A title or tagline needs a graceful upward exit before the next scene cuts in.

components.name: Bokeh Title
components.description: A serif headline sharpens out of drifting bokeh lights.
components.useFor: An opening title for a premium or lifestyle launch where the headline should resolve from a blur of lights.

components.name: Boss Bar
components.description: A boss HP bar is drained by hits, then 'DEFEATED' slams in beneath 'The old workflow'.
components.useFor: A playful beat framing a legacy workflow as a boss that your features defeat one hit at a time.

components.name: Bottom-Up Letters
components.description: Letters rise from below in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time, with zero blur.
components.useFor: A short punchy word or acronym should land with clear, visible per-character energy.

components.name: Bug Dock
components.description: "Playing on every screen you ship." with a small broadcast logo bug docking at the bottom.
components.useFor: A broadcast-style title where the brand shrinks into a corner bug and the message takes over.

components.name: Caret Letter
components.description: A blinking caret types a word and turns into its letter l: 'launch'.
components.useFor: A brand or product-name reveal where a text caret becomes one letter of the name.

components.name: Caret Swap
components.description: A gradient caret swells into a block that consumes the first phrase right-to-left, collapses back and types the second phrase out with a blinking caret.
components.useFor: One phrase should be replaced by another through a caret gesture: the cursor swells into a block that eats the old text, collapses back and types the new one.

components.name: Case Flip
components.description: A headline flips letter by letter from lower to upper and back to its final casing.
components.useFor: A headline beat where the casing itself is the joke, such as a quiet word turning LOUD.

components.name: Centered Word Build
components.description: Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes cumulatively closer on every beat, then clears through a soft left-to-right opacity wipe.
components.useFor: A short statement should assemble one word at a time while every visible prefix stays centered and pushes closer.

components.name: Changed Mind
components.description: A big serif pull quote, "The only tool I use now.", with a solo-founder attribution.
components.useFor: A testimonial that shows a customer's opinion evolving over time, with one quote edited in place.

components.name: Changelog Scroll
components.description: A changelog list scrolls and one row enlarges into a highlighted headline entry.
components.useFor: A what's-new beat that shows a long history of releases and zooms into the latest one.

components.name: Chore Fold
components.description: A teal "Captions does all of that." folds the chore away, "You just talk." beneath.
components.useFor: A before-and-after beat where a list of chores is replaced by one product line.

components.name: Chromatic Wave
components.description: A soft wave travels down through the type; where it crosses, the letters ripple and split into RGB fringes.
components.useFor: A held title — an album cover, a poster hold, a loop — needs slow, ambient distortion instead of a one-shot entrance.

components.name: Chunk Stack
components.description: "learn motion by making it" stacks one word per line with a yellow highlighter on "making".
components.useFor: A short slogan where each word gets its own line and one word is marked with a highlighter.

components.name: Column Reflow
components.description: A justified paragraph reflows its column width, redistributing lines with even word spacing.
components.useFor: A beat about layout, responsiveness or editorial typography where the text itself reflows.

components.name: Comet Headline
components.description: A headline and subhead arrive while a comet streaks arcs behind it, 'Every launch beat, already in orbit.'.
components.useFor: A feature announcement where each word of the headline should be delivered with a trailing light.

components.name: Cool Down
components.description: A short statement, 'Runs cool.', settles in large over a faint grid with a mono caption.
components.useFor: A performance or efficiency claim where the visuals should feel calm and settled.

components.name: Cooling Type
components.description: "What if your launch video could write itself?" cools in, ending on an italic word and a caret.
components.useFor: A question or hook line that should feel written live, ending on an emphasized word.

components.name: Counter Reveal
components.description: A huge front word reveals through the counters of its letters on a blue gradient.
components.useFor: A bold one-word status beat such as Beta or Live that hides a secondary line inside its letters.

components.name: Cover Ring
components.description: An audio-style bar meter sits above the line "They're composed" over green light.
components.useFor: A launch statement over a collage of product photos that collapses into a punchline caption.

components.name: Coy Denial
components.description: A huge "Don't check the site at nine." with a sheepish "(Do.)" tucked into the corner.
components.useFor: A teaser where a loud denial is quietly undone by a tiny aside.

components.name: Crew of One
components.description: A credits roll, Written by / Directed by / Shipped by, all pointing at a big "you".
components.useFor: A credits-roll joke where one person plays every role, ending on who they are.

components.name: Crunch
components.description: A timestamped story line, "It shipped, with time to ...", fades in over a dark brown ground.
components.useFor: A short story beat about a deadline, told in timestamped lines that build pressure.

components.name: Cursor Frame
components.description: A selection frame with handles and a size badge is dragged around a two-line headline.
components.useFor: A design-tool style beat where the headline is selected, moved and resized live.

components.name: Cut Off
components.description: A line is cut off by a white reply card: "Or let the code cut it.".
components.useFor: A joke where a long, tedious explanation is interrupted by a short, better answer.

components.name: Deadpan Box
components.description: A flat, deadpan quote in a blue box with a small attribution line.
components.useFor: A joke or punchline beat where a quiet setup is flipped by the attribution that follows.

components.name: Depth Headline
components.description: A huge serif headline sits behind a gradient sphere that slides through it for depth.
components.useFor: A product name or hero word that should feel layered with an object in front of it.

components.name: Diff Swap
components.description: A before line is diffed into the after line, ending 'Install the scene. Edit the props.'.
components.useFor: A dev-tool beat showing the old painful way replaced by the new one.

components.name: Dot Type
components.description: Words are drawn from a field of round dots in a gradient, the last one in accent.
components.useFor: A rapid sequence of single words such as Think, Make, Ship, each formed from dots.

components.name: Double Take
components.description: "Read that again." above an oversized pink "One person" on blue.
components.useFor: A surprising claim that deserves a second look, such as a team-size or time-to-make stat.

components.name: Drop Timer
components.description: A countdown to a drop ends in a huge gradient 'LIVE NOW' with a URL and logo.
components.useFor: A product drop or launch teaser that counts down and smashes into a huge LIVE NOW payoff.

components.name: Echo Stack
components.description: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.
components.useFor: A one-word statement (a value, a promise) should hold the screen for a while and still feel alive.

components.name: Edge Fit
components.description: A single huge cream word, 'recaps', fills the frame edge to edge with a caption and logo.
components.useFor: A rapid word montage where each word fills the frame edge to edge.

components.name: Edit Ripple
components.description: "Change your mind, render it again." with the second line indented and ripple-coloured.
components.useFor: A beat about cause and effect, such as one edit changing the whole video.

components.name: Ellipsis Resolve
components.description: Three dots pulse and resolve into a gradient word and a closing period.
components.useFor: A loading-to-done beat where a thinking indicator turns into a result word like Shipped.

components.name: Embargo Lift
components.description: "remocn is free, open source and out today" in condensed type with a green accent.
components.useFor: A launch-day announcement where the key facts are revealed from behind redaction bars.

components.name: Enhance Count
components.description: A blurred line sharpens in place, 'Draft it fast. Finish it sharp.', the last word accented.
components.useFor: A before and after message about quality, such as a rough draft becoming a finished piece.

components.name: Escalate Cards
components.description: Cards flash one word each, accelerating until the last word fills the frame over a date.
components.useFor: A rapid build-up where single words flash on cards, faster each time, until the last fills the frame.

components.name: Exactly
components.description: A yellow "Exactly." lands first, then "It's just code." completes the answer.
components.useFor: A beat that answers common objections with a one-word agreement.

components.name: Extrude Pop
components.description: A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved.
components.useFor: A short punchy word — a score, a verdict, a CTA — should land with physical weight, like a stamp rising off the page.

components.name: Factor Out
components.description: Three short imperatives stack above a big blue "in your editor.".
components.useFor: A feature beat where several actions share one location, tool or result.

components.name: Fade Through
components.description: A Material-style content transition: old fades out, new fades in with a soft delay.
components.useFor: One label, stat, or short phrase needs to swap cleanly into another in the same slot.

components.name: Feather Settle
components.description: "Your launch, landing softly." settles in as if falling like a feather on a taupe ground.
components.useFor: A calm, reassuring closing line such as a soft landing or a gentle sign-off.

components.name: Feature Chips Flow
components.description: Rows of feature pills stream by, then snap into a cluster around the logo.
components.useFor: A feature overview where rows of pills stream past and then snap into a cluster around the product logo.

components.name: Feature Headline
components.description: A tag pill opens from the left, then a headline rises: 'Captions that move with every word.'.
components.useFor: A feature spotlight with a New tag, a one-line headline and a short subhead.

components.name: Feature Trio
components.description: Three feature words, 'Fast. Composable. Open source.', rise from masks with progress ticks and notes.
components.useFor: A three-benefit summary beat for a product, one short word per benefit.

components.name: Filler Cut
components.description: A transcript has its filler words cut, leaving a clean line, 'Ship your launch video today.'.
components.useFor: A captions or editing-tool demo that shows filler words being removed from speech.

components.name: Fine Print Up
components.description: "No account and no watermark. Ever." in a big serif with tiny fine print at the bottom.
components.useFor: A terms or licensing beat where each promise turns into a line of fine print.

components.name: Flank Roll Swap
components.description: "Out now ... on remocn.dev" rolls its flanking words around a sunset image in the middle.
components.useFor: A release announcement that swaps a studio name for an out-now line around a hero image.

components.name: Flick Swap
components.description: A headline flicks into place with a gradient second line, 'Grounds that never sit still.'.
components.useFor: A feature rundown where several one-line claims cycle through in one scene.

components.name: Focus Blur Resolve
components.description: A premium focus pull from heavy blur to crisp text, then a soft blur-out exit.
components.useFor: A hero word or short phrase should feel like a camera lens pulling into focus.

components.name: Focus Front Swap
components.description: A headline pulls focus front-to-back to swap its last word to "tonight".
components.useFor: A rhythmic three-line pitch that ends on a call to ship now.

components.name: Focus Pan Text
components.description: Blurred earlier lines stack above while focus pans down to "You're ready to launch." and a toolbar.
components.useFor: A step-by-step status sequence, such as checks passing, ending on a ready message.

components.name: Fog Rise
components.description: Display text resolves out of fog: characters sharpen from heavy blur center-out with vertical streaks dissolving above them, as if rising along the z-axis.
components.useFor: A big display word should materialize out of atmosphere — already at its size and position, resolving from heavy blur as if rising along the z-axis.

components.name: Font Cycle
components.description: One word cycles through several typefaces and settles in its final face.
components.useFor: A branding beat showing the same word in many typefaces before the chosen one lands.

components.name: Full Bleed Type
components.description: Huge condensed caps words slam in one at a time, the last lit by a sunrise gradient.
components.useFor: A fast slogan where huge condensed caps words slam in one at a time and the last one lights up.

components.name: Glass Capsule
components.description: A glass capsule slides over the focus word of a two-line headline, magnifying it in italic.
components.useFor: A headline where one key word should be magnified and re-styled as the point.

components.name: Glyph Anatomy
components.description: A word builds as in a font editor, with metric guides, anchors along each contour and Bézier handles that pull straight segments into curves before the glyphs fill.
components.useFor: A product for designers, a type or a design tool, should show its craft: the letters are built from points and curves on screen.

components.name: Glyph Relay
components.description: "Building a product" hands off between lines until a giant question mark resolves into "Launching it?".
components.useFor: A setup-and-twist story beat where a phrase hands off between lines and ends on a giant question mark.

components.name: Gooey Morph
components.description: Bars fly in Tetris-style, land as a row, and melt into a word through a gooey blur-and-threshold morph.
components.useFor: A title reveal should feel liquid and organic — shapes fuse and hand their mass to the word instead of crossfading.

components.name: Got Em
components.description: A suspense line resolves into an exploded 'GOT 'EM' over a gradient sunburst.
components.useFor: A playful payoff for a giveaway or entry: a suspense line that explodes into a huge GOT EM.

components.name: Gradient Scale Cut Text
components.description: An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a separate compact blurred line that settles left while the reveal continues.
components.useFor: A title should begin at an imposing scale and resolve through a deliberately abrupt editorial cut.

components.name: Grid Cell
components.description: A grid cell lights up and 'Introducing remocn 2.0' is typed into it with a mono label.
components.useFor: An announcement framed as a design-tool grid cell, such as a version or product name.

components.name: Half Built
components.description: A sentence where unfinished verbs are outlined and fill in, tagged Summer and Later.
components.useFor: A roadmap beat showing what the product does now and what is coming.

components.name: Hand Count
components.description: A number that counts up in stop-motion poses, rewritten by hand at every pose and freezing still once it lands.
components.useFor: A stat, price, or count belongs in a hand-made scene — the number should arrive by being written, not by rolling.

components.name: Handwrite
components.description: Handwritten text laid down letter by letter on a quantized stop-motion clock, each glyph keeping its own slant and baseline wobble.
components.useFor: Captions, labels, and headlines should read as pen-written on paper — the core text voice of stop-motion scrapbook scenes.

components.name: Headline to Line
components.description: A headline settles and its phrase collapses toward a single line over a glowing horizon.
components.useFor: A hero headline that should collapse into a sentence and finish typing a longer description.

components.name: Hidden Word
components.description: A word is found hidden inside a sentence and lifted out as a large italic title.
components.useFor: A reveal beat where a key word is concealed in a sentence and then pulled out as the headline.

components.name: Hook Uncurl
components.description: Stacked condensed caps lines uncurl into place, ending on 'Just make the video.'.
components.useFor: A hook that asks a question in stacked condensed caps and answers it as the lines uncurl.

components.name: Hot Stage
components.description: A short line, 'Clear the tower.', beside a faint mono mission log of timed stage events.
components.useFor: A closing beat that walks through build, render and ship stages, each new line displacing the last.

components.name: Idea Set
components.description: Two ruled lines set like a ledger, the second in an accent color: 'Napkin sketch. Keynote opener.'.
components.useFor: A two-line rough-to-finished beat where the second line is the payoff.

components.name: in Proportion
components.description: Small objections ("It'll look homemade") are answered by a big yellow "You'll write a component.".
components.useFor: An objection-handling beat where each customer worry is answered by a bigger, brighter reply.

components.name: Indent Steps
components.description: Three lines step in with growing indents and line numbers like code: 'Write it in React...'.
components.useFor: A write, render, ship sequence that should read like steps in an editor.

components.name: Index List
components.description: A numbered feature index where hairline rows highlight one by one with an arrow.
components.useFor: A what's-inside beat that lists the main features of a release and lands on the one that matters most.

components.name: Infinite Marquee
components.description: Seamlessly looping horizontal text strip with optional stroke style.
components.useFor: A scene needs ambient motion in the background or as a decorative band between sections.

components.name: Ink Underline
components.description: A hand-dragged brush underline that sweeps itself across in a few stop-motion poses, thinning to a dry tail.
components.useFor: A hand-dragged ink underline belongs beneath a written headline, URL, or stat — pairs with `handwrite`, with `delay` set from `handwriteDuration`.

components.name: Inline Highlight
components.description: Animates one word inside a sentence from a base color to a brand color.
components.useFor: One keyword inside a sentence needs to draw attention through a color shift without any background decoration.

components.name: Inline Pill Takeover
components.description: A clipped pill expands inside a sentence, physically pushes the surrounding words apart, removes them through blur and takes over the frame with a fast camera punch-in.
components.useFor: A sentence should transform an inline placeholder into a CTA without cutting to a separate title card.

components.name: Inline Word Roll
components.description: Roll through words beside a fixed prefix with accelerating timing and smoothly centered width.
components.useFor: A headline keeps its opening phrase while cycling through audiences, benefits or outcomes.

components.name: Intelligence Glow
components.description: An AI-style answer types under a question while a soft glow breathes along an underline.
components.useFor: An AI feature beat that shows a prompt and its one-line answer, like a generated result.

components.name: Italic Speed
components.description: A slanted caps word rides in on speed strips with a serif italic subtitle under an underline.
components.useFor: A speed or performance claim such as Faster that should feel like it is moving.

components.name: Keep Words
components.description: Three serif lines, "Written. Yours. On time.", each ending with a red full stop.
components.useFor: A closing manifesto beat with two or three beliefs that each boil down to one word.

components.name: Kerning Snap
components.description: Loose letters snap to correct kerning one by one in a gradient serif word.
components.useFor: A design-craft beat about typesetting, details or polish, where a word assembles precisely.

components.name: Kill Feed
components.description: A kill-feed of eliminations builds to a big gradient 'PENTA SHIP' banner.
components.useFor: A playful recap where each shipped win lands as a kill in a game-style feed.

components.name: Kinetic Center Build
components.description: A word appears in the center; each new word enters from the right and pushes the line until the full phrase locks centered.
components.useFor: A short headline should build word by word with satisfying kinetic momentum, locking centered at the end.

components.name: Kinetic Morph Text
components.description: Letters lift, rotate, and softly reshape into editable phrases with sampled outline trails.
components.useFor: A short sequence of phrases should feel like the same letters physically rearranging.

components.name: Kinetic Warp
components.description: A coarse mesh warp bends a whole word in staccato beats, one axis per keyframe.
components.useFor: A short, heavy display word needs a bold kinetic-typography moment where the whole word bends and snaps instead of individual letters animating.

components.name: Known Terms
components.description: Definitions, "A scene is a component ...", build to a green "Your launch is a deploy.".
components.useFor: A beat that maps familiar concepts to your product, such as a scene is a component.

components.name: Ko Count
components.description: A knockout count ends in a full-frame gradient slam, 'KNOCKOUT', with a serif subline.
components.useFor: A launch beat that builds suspense with a quick count to ten before a big verdict word.

components.name: Landing Confirmed
components.description: A descent counts down then a big gradient 'SHIPPED.' lands over a serif 'Nailed the landing.'.
components.useFor: A ship-day beat that treats the release like a landing: countdown, impact, then the big word.

components.name: Layout Swap
components.description: Headlines swap by shifting layout, ending 'Animations, transitions and backgrounds, ready to install.'.
components.useFor: A feature headline that builds from one noun to a full promise.

components.name: Layover
components.description: A headline's key word cycles through a short list of stops before settling on the final word.
components.useFor: A journey beat where a word steps through intermediate stops before arriving.

components.name: Less More
components.description: 'Less explaining.' dims while 'More showing.' lands in bright blue below it.
components.useFor: A short manifesto beat that sets old effort against new payoff.

components.name: Letter Relay
components.description: Letters hop in sequence, each taking off as the previous one lands, to spell the wordmark.
components.useFor: A brand or product name needs a playful reveal at the start of a launch video, one letter hopping after another.

components.name: Lights Out
components.description: Five lights go out and a heavy italic headline slams in, with a blue period.
components.useFor: A launch countdown moment where the lights go out and the product name hits.

components.name: Line-by-Line Slide
components.description: Each line enters from the left with a staggered slide and exits to the right for a flowing paragraph reveal.
components.useFor: A multi-line headline or short paragraph needs a flowing, line-by-line entrance with a matching exit.

components.name: Line Relief
components.description: Huge LAUNCH lettering is relief-ruled by stacked horizontal lines over a dusk gradient.
components.useFor: A hero title card where one huge word should first read as a topographic or radar-style relief.

components.name: Liquid Word
components.description: A word melts into a gradient pool, then a new word rises out of it.
components.useFor: A before-and-after beat where an old word dissolves into the new one, such as draft turning into shipped.

components.name: Long Vowel
components.description: A serif word stretches one vowel, 'Waaaaaay', in a warm gradient with an italic caption.
components.useFor: A tagline that plays on emphasis, like a word drawn out for comic effect, followed by a short punchline.

components.name: Loop Break
components.description: A loop of "Render the cut. Spot a typo." breaks into "Change one word. Done.".
components.useFor: A before and after beat that contrasts a tedious repeating workflow with a one-step fix.

components.name: Macro Letter Pan
components.description: The camera pans in macro across letters to land the phrase "Ready to launch.".
components.useFor: A closing line where one word is the payoff and the camera should dwell on it before revealing the sentence.

components.name: Macro Pan
components.description: A serif headline is revealed by a close-up pan across its glyphs, ending on a gradient.
components.useFor: A title that should feel shot with a macro lens, scanning across the letterforms.

components.name: Magnet Letters
components.description: A wrong word is repelled by magnet and the right word drops in: 'Launch videos, in code.'.
components.useFor: A correction beat in a sentence, such as swapping one word for the better word, shown as a physical gag.

components.name: Marker Highlight
components.description: Colored marker block draws behind a phrase as the text color shifts.
components.useFor: A key phrase inside a sentence needs a physical, hand-drawn-feeling highlight that visually underscores the word.

components.name: Mask Reveal Up
components.description: Lines reveal upward with a soft masked feel and compact stagger.
components.useFor: A multi-line headline or stacked list needs a clean, contained upward reveal that holds on screen.

components.name: Matrix Decode
components.description: Random scramble resolves left-to-right into the target text.
components.useFor: A hacker, terminal, or cyberpunk aesthetic is required and the scramble-to-reveal glyph effect is on-brand.

components.name: Micro Scale Fade
components.description: A calm, tiny scale pop used as subtle premium polish for labels and headings.
components.useFor: A label, subheading, or supporting text needs an entrance that feels polished without drawing attention to itself.

components.name: Mono Settle
components.description: Two lines set in monospace settle into proportional type: 'From your editor to the edit.'.
components.useFor: A developer-flavored message about moving from code to a finished result.

components.name: Mono Voice
components.description: Three stacked lines shift voice mid-line, ending in a large accent 'delivery.'.
components.useFor: A script-to-delivery message where the final word should be bigger and more expressive.

components.name: Moves Up
components.description: A Now/Next/Later roadmap list where the current item moves up and enlarges.
components.useFor: A roadmap beat showing what is shipping now and what is coming next.

components.name: Name Gloss
components.description: Two big words, "Brand kit", each get a small gloss line and a closing teal sentence.
components.useFor: A naming beat where a two-part product or feature name is unpacked word by word.

components.name: Ndot Resolve
components.description: A headline scans in as a dot-matrix face, then refreshes letter by letter into solid type.
components.useFor: A tech or hardware flavored title that should look like a display refreshing to final type.

components.name: Negation Drop
components.description: Condensed caps poster where each line's key word drops in on a lime highlight block.
components.useFor: A myth-busting beat where objections like you can't animate flip into you can.

components.name: No Buts
components.description: A hesitant "But..." is answered by a yellow "Go on. We'll wait.".
components.useFor: An objection-handling beat where each hesitation gets a short, confident reply.

components.name: Nonstop
components.description: A stops counter ticks down from three until the line resolves to the big phrase 'No stops'.
components.useFor: A beat about a shorter path, such as steps removed between idea and export.

components.name: Not Yet
components.description: A stack of "It can't ... Yet." lines, the last one brightest, each ending in an orange "Yet.".
components.useFor: A roadmap or honesty beat that admits current limits, each one ending in a hopeful word.

components.name: Number Wheel
components.description: Mechanical odometer that rolls an integer up or down to its target, direction inferred from the values.
components.useFor: A metric, stat, or count should animate to its value in a satisfying odometer roll.

components.name: on Approach
components.description: 'Wheels up' stays fixed while the time phrase swaps from 'in June' down to 'today.'.
components.useFor: A launch countdown beat, such as in June, next week, tomorrow, today.

components.name: Out of Context
components.description: "Stop making launch videos by hand." with the last words in pink on a blue ground.
components.useFor: A punchy slogan where the final phrase flips the meaning, such as Stop making launch videos by hand.

components.name: Outline Fill Track Text
components.description: A rising lead word gives way to an outlined value that fills from left to right while both travel on one continuous track.
components.useFor: A statement should hand focus from a lead word to a large numeric value in one continuous move.

components.name: Outline Trace
components.description: Every glyph contour draws itself as a stroke, letter by letter, then the fill wipes up inside each letter and the stroke fades into it.
components.useFor: A title should be drawn rather than revealed, like a trim path running around the real letterforms.

components.name: Oval Type
components.description: Each word rides inside its own glossy gradient capsule, finishing as a three-capsule poster.
components.useFor: A feature rundown that cycles through verbs before landing a short three-word tagline.

components.name: Overheard
components.description: A question quote, "Who made our launch video?", answered by "I did. It's in the repo.".
components.useFor: A question-and-answer exchange between two people, such as a customer or colleague overheard.

components.name: Overnight
components.description: A dated story line, "The demo went up before the launch post did.", on a yellow ground.
components.useFor: A founder or customer story with a deadline that plays out across one evening, night and morning.

components.name: Parallax Lockup
components.description: A three-line headline locks up with parallax, the last line in a gradient.
components.useFor: A multi-line brand statement that should settle into a tight typographic lockup.

components.name: Pass Swap
components.description: An object passes across the frame and each pass swaps the headline to the next one.
components.useFor: A three-line pitch where each beat is punctuated by a moving object.

components.name: Path Ride
components.description: A line draws itself along a curve with the text riding behind its head, then the curve pulls taut and the text settles on a straight, centered baseline.
components.useFor: A tagline or a short phrase should travel across the frame before it settles, leading the eye from one side to the other.

components.name: Path Text
components.description: Text starts along a loose path then straightens into a clean line with an italic tail.
components.useFor: A before and after message about going from rough to refined.

components.name: Peek Shut
components.description: "Want a peek?" is cut off by a shutter: "That's all you get. The rest, Monday.".
components.useFor: A teaser beat that shows a sliver of the product and then withholds the rest until launch day.

components.name: Per Character Rise
components.description: Letters slide up from below with no blur — crisp, deliberate, kinetic.
components.useFor: A short word or phrase needs a crisp, sharp character-by-character entrance with even, readable stagger.

components.name: Per-Word Crossfade
components.description: Words gently fade into place one after another, with a short vertical drift for a calm keynote rhythm.
components.useFor: Two short phrases need to swap with a soft, word-by-word transition that reads as calm and composed.

components.name: Period Drop
components.description: A word rises out of its line, then a colored dot falls from above the frame, bounces with squash and stretch, and settles as the period.
components.useFor: An end card or a logo lockup should land with one physical, memorable beat.

components.name: Perspective Marquee
components.description: A 3D-tilted infinite marquee with depth-of-field blur on items rolling toward the horizon.
components.useFor: A dark, cinematic background treatment is needed with text rolling into a 3D vanishing point.

components.name: Perspective Squeeze
components.description: Two lines of heavy type endlessly trade height while corner-pinned perspective bends the flat stack into receding planes.
components.useFor: A looping hold — an outro, a background title, a stream screen — needs constant, hypnotic typographic motion (the 225-frame track ends where it starts).

components.name: Photo Caret
components.description: A three-line headline types out with a caret while product photos float around it.
components.useFor: A brand statement that should be written live with photos orbiting the text.

components.name: Photo Fill Type
components.description: A word cut out of the stage reveals a generated mountain landscape and a caption.
components.useFor: A bold one-word title that should open into an image, such as a landscape or product shot.

components.name: Phrase List Bridge
components.description: An inline highlight chip bridges two phrases: "Browse through ... ready-made scenes".
components.useFor: A beat that shows many options and then lands on one, such as browsing scenes and choosing a favorite.

components.name: Pinned Word
components.description: A serif italic word is pinned in a sentence while the rest changes, 'Own every video frame.'.
components.useFor: A message where one keyword stays constant across several claims.

components.name: Pitch Blanks
components.description: A fill-in-the-blank pitch where product, category and audience labels annotate each underlined phrase.
components.useFor: A positioning beat that frames the pitch as a fill-in-the-blank: product, category, audience.

components.name: Plain License
components.description: A big green "Free," then "for anyone, for anything." in condensed type.
components.useFor: A trust beat that translates a license or terms into a few plain words, such as free, for anyone, for anything.

components.name: Point Expand
components.description: Short statements land one at a time, ending 'Copy, paste, render.' with a pulsing accent period.
components.useFor: A run of two to five punchy claims, each building on the last, with a bold accent change between them.

components.name: Point Intro
components.description: A headline is written word by word and a colored point lands after it: 'Introducing remocn 2.0.'.
components.useFor: A product announcement opener where one confident headline is written out and a colored point lands as the full stop.

components.name: Post Script
components.description: A red card with a "Thanks for watching" line and a "P.S. The next launch film is yours.".
components.useFor: A closing card that thanks the viewer and then drops a final call to action as a P.S.

components.name: Poster Crop
components.description: A poster headline crops in tight, line by line, over a ruled blue ground.
components.useFor: A launch poster beat where a big headline crops in tight over a ruled ground with a kicker and date.

components.name: Prompt Restyle
components.description: A headline is restyled by prompt instructions, ending in a serif italic gradient 'you own'.
components.useFor: A beat showing how an AI prompt reshapes copy: typed instructions that make a headline bigger, tighter and styled.

components.name: Pull in
components.description: 'Now in' stays put while spaced-out place words pull into view, such as vertical, 4K, your codebase.
components.useFor: A platform-coverage beat, such as now in vertical, 4K and your codebase.

components.name: Pulse Line
components.description: A heartbeat-style pulse runs through 'Every frame has a pulse.' with the last word in teal.
components.useFor: A product beat about speed or liveness where a heartbeat pulse runs through the headline.

components.name: Quote Hero
components.description: A big pull quote with an underlined italic phrase and a named founder attribution.
components.useFor: A customer testimonial in a launch or case-study video, with the key phrase marked.

components.name: Rep Stack
components.description: One caps word is repeated in a stack of outlines and fills, with a blue accent period.
components.useFor: A one-word statement about repetition or iteration, like AGAIN. or REPEAT.

components.name: Rewrite Bars
components.description: Bars sweep over a headline to rewrite it, 'Your launch video, rendered from code.'.
components.useFor: A feature walkthrough where one headline is rewritten into the next as bars sweep across it.

components.name: RGB Glitch Text
components.description: Three RGB-offset text copies jitter for a brief glitch window.
components.useFor: A tech, hacker, or cyberpunk scene needs a moment of digital corruption on a title.

components.name: Riddle Clues
components.description: A tiny teaser line, "Give up? Answer on the 14th.", sits low in an empty dark frame.
components.useFor: A teaser campaign beat that hints at the product through a few what it has but what it lacks riddles.

components.name: Ring Text
components.description: Text runs around a tilted 3D band that spins, reading on the near side and mirrored on the far side.
components.useFor: A headline needs a dimensional object next to it, and the object itself should carry a short phrase.

components.name: Rolling Number
components.description: Odometer where every place rolls at its own speed, new places rising into view, settling exactly on the target value.
components.useFor: Animating a large integer metric on a stats or milestone slide (revenue, signups, impressions).

components.name: Rolodex Flip
components.description: Cycles a word through a list of values with a 3D rolodex card flip while an invisible sizer keeps the line width and baseline stable.
components.useFor: Cycling package, feature, or value names inside a held line — install commands, "works with X" beats, plan-name cycling.

components.name: Round Slam
components.description: 'ROUND 1' slams in, then 'SHIP!' punches over a red slashed band.
components.useFor: A game-style announcement beat: a round or level call followed by a one-word finisher.

components.name: Rsvp
components.description: "You're invited." with a what/when/where table ending on an RSVP install command.
components.useFor: A launch or event invite that spells out what, when and where, ending on how to join.

components.name: Rubberband Word
components.description: A cursor grabs a word by its last letter, stretches it and snaps it into a new word.
components.useFor: A tension-and-release beat where a word is pulled tight and then snaps into its resolution.

components.name: Ruby Press
components.description: A word is pressed out and swapped from a list: 'Subtitles for every market in one render.'.
components.useFor: A claim like subtitles for every market where the time frame keeps shrinking.

components.name: Ruler Align
components.description: A ruler slides under a text line and straightens its letters onto the edge: 'Made to measure.'.
components.useFor: A message about precision, polish or alignment where messy text snaps into order.

components.name: Run on
components.description: A sentence, "Or change one", trails off with a joiner and an orange dot.
components.useFor: A pain-point beat that shows a tedious workflow as one exhausting sentence before the fix.

components.name: Rush Type
components.description: A resting white word blasts through vertical scale motion, separating into energy-conserving RGB shutter trails before the next word resolves.
components.useFor: A short phrase should cycle one forceful word at a time.

components.name: Said Who
components.description: A big serif pull quote, "Took me one evening.", with a backend-engineer attribution.
components.useFor: A single short quote whose credibility comes from who said it, revealed bit by bit.

components.name: Scale Down Fade
components.description: Subtle premium settle-in with a restrained scale-down fade on exit.
components.useFor: A headline needs a confident, minimal entrance without any kinetic exaggeration.

components.name: Scan Reveal
components.description: A scan line reveals a headline over an underline with a small subtitle below.
components.useFor: A section title where a scan line sweeps down and reveals the headline over an underline.

components.name: Scissors Cut
components.description: Scissors cut a word out of a line and another slides into the gap: 'Launch today.'.
components.useFor: A tagline where one phrase is cut out and replaced, such as swapping a slow timeline for a fast one.

components.name: Script Cut
components.description: "and every piece became a shot." with a tiny script line and cut ticks below.
components.useFor: A how-we-made-it beat that shows one written line being split into separate shots.

components.name: Scrub Reveal
components.description: A sentence scrubs into view while one highlighted phrase switches to editorial italic gradient.
components.useFor: A manifesto or value statement that should read like scrolling through a page and lighting up as you go.

components.name: Select Replace
components.description: A text selection highlights a phrase and is replaced by new styled words.
components.useFor: An editor-style beat that rewrites a slow plan into a fast one.

components.name: Selection Snap
components.description: A thin word in a loose viewfinder snaps into a design-tool selection while it goes from Thin to Black, pops its handles and counts up a size badge.
components.useFor: A single word should read as something being designed: a design tool, a component library, a type or layout feature.

components.name: Serif Rise
components.description: A large serif line rises into place, 'From rough cut to final cut.', end phrase in red.
components.useFor: An emotional or editorial line, like a before-and-after claim, that should feel crafted rather than techy.

components.name: Shader Text Reveal
components.description: Reveal words through the original OpenShaders hero shader, then settle into white type.
components.useFor: A short headline needs the hero shader reveal, one word at a time.

components.name: Shadow Sweep Text
components.description: A line rises up and left while one dense dark shadow uncovers it and a second shadow sweeps back across it for the exit.
components.useFor: A short statement should emerge through a dense shadow instead of fading or clipping into view.

components.name: Shared Axis Y
components.description: Per-word hard-cut transition with staircase timing for sharp editorial swaps.
components.useFor: Swapping two text values in a slide-deck style transition (A → B → C chained in `<Sequence>`).

components.name: Shared Axis Z
components.description: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.
components.useFor: Conveying a zoom-in narrative: moving from a broad context to a focused point.

components.name: Shed Weight
components.description: 'Sharp at any size.' repeats at growing sizes, weight adjusting per size, with pt labels.
components.useFor: A typography-focused beat showing that a typeface holds up from tiny to huge sizes.

components.name: Sheen Slide In
components.description: A title glides in from the right with an exponential settle and a slow final creep to center, while a gradient sheen sweeps once through the glyphs.
components.useFor: An intro title should arrive with momentum — a fast entrance, a long exponential settle and a barely visible final creep into center.

components.name: Shimmer Sweep
components.description: Light shine sweeps across muted text via background-clip:text.
components.useFor: Highlighting a product name or pricing tier with a refined, metallic gleam — luxury SaaS, pricing slides.

components.name: Short Slide Down
components.description: Each new word drops in from above into its own line and pushes the stack downward until a centered three-line composition locks in place.
components.useFor: A multi-word headline should build its layout visibly — each word stacking to create a composed block.

components.name: Short Slide Right
components.description: The whole phrase glides in from the left as one compact move while words reveal in sequence through opacity.
components.useFor: A short headline should enter with horizontal momentum — reads as forward motion or progress.

components.name: Slash Wipe
components.description: A gradient slash wipes across and reveals a large title, '/transitions', with a one-line sub.
components.useFor: A section title card where a bright slash wipes across and reveals a big title with a one-line sub.

components.name: Slide Doors
components.description: Two panels slide apart like doors to reveal 'Arriving in your repo.' with an accent word.
components.useFor: A rhythmic three-line pitch where each line is pushed out by the next, like doors sliding apart.

components.name: Slit Scan
components.description: A word is slit-scanned into view through fluted slices, with a speed stat in the caption.
components.useFor: A speed or performance claim where a single word resolves out of a streaked, fluted blur.

components.name: Slot Machine Roll
components.description: Vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.
components.useFor: Revealing a price change, plan upgrade, or before/after value where the string includes symbols (`$`, `%`, `×`).

components.name: Soft Blur In
components.description: Per-character fade-in with a gentle blur and upward motion. Apple's signature hero-title reveal.
components.useFor: A hero headline needs the Apple-style per-character soft reveal — premium, airy, cinematic.

components.name: Sold Out
components.description: A stock counter races to zero, then a tilted chrome-gradient 'SOLD OUT' band slams across.
components.useFor: A scarcity beat for a limited drop, showing stock draining before a sold-out stamp.

components.name: Speed Ramp Word
components.description: Time slows on the key word as it warms to a gradient, with a timecode HUD.
components.useFor: A line that rushes by and drops into slow motion on one key word for emphasis.

components.name: Spine Turn
components.description: Vertical titles turn like book spines, handing off to a large accent 'Wrap-up'.
components.useFor: An agenda or chapter sequence where each title hands off to the next and stacks as a spine.

components.name: Split Word
components.description: A huge word splits open and a second word slides into the gap with a gradient band.
components.useFor: A 'Now Available' style reveal where a status word appears inside the headline itself.

components.name: Spotlight Text
components.description: A spotlight travels across a dark headline, 'Launch videos, in code.', with a mono eyebrow.
components.useFor: A tech or developer-tool headline revealed by a spotlight that travels across dark type.

components.name: Spring Scale In
components.description: Words pop in with a soft overshoot scale, like a physical spring settling into place.
components.useFor: The scene calls for energy and bounce — product launches, celebration moments, fun CTAs.

components.name: Squeeze In
components.description: Characters appear one by one on a tight stagger; when the last one lands, every letter gap compresses as one and the word squeezes together.
components.useFor: A wordmark or short title should be uncovered by a clean wipe, as if a background-colored cover slides off it.

components.name: Squeeze Out
components.description: Condensed text squeezes out of the frame line by line, ending 'Freshly pressed frames.'.
components.useFor: A headline that should feel pressed out and then settling, like a fresh print.

components.name: Stack Letters
components.description: Letters tumble and stack into place to spell a caps word over a warm gradient.
components.useFor: A one-word title card for a release or milestone where the letters should physically land.

components.name: Staggered Fade Up
components.description: Words fade in and slide up one after another with a configurable delay.
